sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_c4f1621bf0621985f01e0746f7331fa6
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.AppProperties</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Typed accessors for the sixteen scoped properties including the 6 to 48 hour cadence clamp, the one log severity policy, the per source last successful run marker, the LinkedIn API version and the clamped staging retention and minimisation ages. Implements prompt 4.0 and 3.0 configuration.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AppProperties</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var AppProperties = Class.create();
AppProperties.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.PREFIX = 'x_bst_startuptrk.';
    },

    /* The LinkedIn API version the LinkedIn-Version request header carries, in the
       provider's YYYYMM form. Prompt 4.0. */
    LINKEDIN_API_VERSION: '202606',

    /* The date and time form every run marker timestamp carries. */
    STAMP: /^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$/,

    /* Severity order, least to most severe, for the debug, info, warn and error choice list of
       logging.level. A severity rank is this list's index. */
    LOG_LEVELS: ['debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error'],

    /* Returns a raw property value with a fallback. */
    get: function (suffix, fallback) {
        var value = gs.getProperty(this.PREFIX + suffix, fallback);
        if (value === null) {
            return fallback;
        }
        if (value === '') {
            return fallback;
        }
        return value;
    },

    /* Returns true when left is numerically below right. */
    _isBelow: function (left, right) {
        if (left === right) {
            return false;
        }
        return left - right === -Math.abs(left - right);
    },

    /* Returns a property coerced to an integer with a fallback. A value that is not a whole
       decimal integer, including a fractional value and a value with trailing characters,
       resolves to the fallback. */
    getInt: function (suffix, fallback) {
        var text = String(this.get(suffix, fallback)).trim();
        if (!/^[+-]?[0-9]+$/.test(text)) {
            return fallback;
        }
        var parsed = parseInt(text, 10);
        if (isNaN(parsed)) {
            return fallback;
        }
        return parsed;
    },

    /* Returns a property coerced to an integer at or above a minimum. A value below the
       minimum resolves to the fallback. */
    getBoundedInt: function (suffix, fallback, minimum) {
        var parsed = this.getInt(suffix, fallback);
        if (this._isBelow(parsed, minimum)) {
            return fallback;
        }
        return parsed;
    },

    /* Returns the ingestion cadence in hours clamped to the 6 to 48 range. Prompt 4.0. */
    getCadenceHours: function () {
        var hours = this.getInt('ingestion.cadence_hours', 24);
        if (hours !== null) {
            if (hours - 6 === -Math.abs(hours - 6)) {
                if (hours !== 6) {
                    hours = 6;
                }
            }
            if (hours - 48 === Math.abs(hours - 48)) {
                if (hours !== 48) {
                    hours = 48;
                }
            }
        }
        return hours;
    },

    /* Returns live or fallback. Prompt 4.0. */
    getSourceMode: function () {
        var mode = String(this.get('ingestion.source_mode', 'live')).toLowerCase();
        if (mode === 'fallback') {
            return 'fallback';
        }
        return 'live';
    },

    /* Returns every run marker the single run-state property carries, keyed by source
       system, together with the bare provenance a value written before the marker format
       carries. Each marker holds the provenance, the state, the timestamp and the run
       identifier that wrote it. Prompt 4.0. */
    readRunMarkers: function () {
        var raw = String(this.get('ingestion.last_run_provenance', '')).trim();
        var markers = { crunchbase: null, linkedin: null, legacy: '' };
        if (raw === '') {
            return markers;
        }
        var bare = raw.toLowerCase();
        if (bare === 'live' || bare === 'fallback') {
            markers.legacy = bare;
            return markers;
        }
        var entries = raw.split(';');
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== entries.length; i++) {
            var parsed = this._parseRunMarker(entries[i]);
            if (parsed !== null) {
                markers[parsed.source] = parsed;
            }
        }
        return markers;
    },

    /* Returns one run marker entry parsed from its serialised form, or null when the
       entry names no known source system or is not well formed. Prompt 4.0. */
    _parseRunMarker: function (entry) {
        var text = String(entry === null ? '' : entry).trim();
        var split = text.indexOf('=');
        if (split === -1) {
            return null;
        }
        var source = this._sourceToken(text.substring(0, split));
        if (source === '') {
            return null;
        }
        var parts = text.substring(split + 1).split('|');
        if (parts.length !== 4) {
            return null;
        }
        var provenance = String(parts[0]).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (provenance !== 'live') {
            if (provenance !== 'fallback') {
                provenance = '';
            }
        }
        var state = String(parts[1]).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (state !== 'running') {
            if (state !== 'succeeded') {
                return null;
            }
        }
        var stamp = String(parts[2]).trim();
        if (!this.STAMP.test(stamp)) {
            return null;
        }
        return {
            source: source,
            provenance: provenance,
            state: state,
            stamp: stamp,
            run: this._runToken(parts[3])
        };
    },

    /* Writes the run-state property from a marker set and returns the value written. The
       property is written only when the serialised value differs from the value on
       record, so an unchanged run state costs no write. Prompt 4.0. */
    _writeRunMarkers: function (markers) {
        var order = ['crunchbase', 'linkedin'];
        var entries = [];
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== order.length; i++) {
            var marker = markers[order[i]];
            if (!marker) {
                continue;
            }
            entries.push(order[i] + '=' + marker.provenance + '|' + marker.state + '|'
                + marker.stamp + '|' + marker.run);
        }
        var value = entries.join(';');
        if (String(this.get('ingestion.last_run_provenance', '')) !== value) {
            gs.setProperty(this.PREFIX + 'ingestion.last_run_provenance', value);
        }
        return value;
    },

    /* Claims one source system for one run and reports whether this run holds the claim.
       A claim held by another run is honoured until it is older than the cadence, after
       which it is taken over. The claim is written and then read back, so the run
       identifier the property carries decides the holder. Prompt 4.0. */
    acquireRunLease: function (sourceSystem, runId) {
        var source = this._sourceToken(sourceSystem);
        var run = this._runToken(runId);
        if (source === '') {
            return { ok: false, holder: '', reason: 'unknown source system' };
        }
        if (run === '') {
            return { ok: false, holder: '', reason: 'the run identifier is not usable' };
        }
        var markers = this.readRunMarkers();
        var held = markers[source];
        if (held) {
            if (held.state === 'running') {
                if (held.run !== run) {
                    if (!this._claimExpired(held.stamp)) {
                        return { ok: false, holder: held.run, reason: 'another run holds this source' };
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        markers[source] = {
            source: source,
            provenance: held ? held.provenance : '',
            state: 'running',
            stamp: new GlideDateTime().getValue(),
            run: run
        };
        this._writeRunMarkers(markers);
        var confirmed = this.readRunMarkers()[source];
        if (!confirmed) {
            return { ok: false, holder: '', reason: 'the claim could not be written' };
        }
        if (confirmed.run !== run) {
            return { ok: false, holder: confirmed.run, reason: 'another run took this source' };
        }
        return { ok: true, holder: run, reason: '' };
    },

    /* Records one source system's run as complete with its provenance and returns the
       timestamp recorded. A provenance outside live and fallback, and a run that does not
       hold the claim, are both refused without writing. Prompt 4.0. */
    completeRun: function (sourceSystem, runId, provenance) {
        var source = this._sourceToken(sourceSystem);
        var run = this._runToken(runId);
        var mode = String(provenance === null ? '' : provenance).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (source === '') {
            return { ok: false, stamp: '', provenance: '', reason: 'unknown source system' };
        }
        if (mode !== 'live') {
            if (mode !== 'fallback') {
                return { ok: false, stamp: '', provenance: '', reason: 'unknown provenance' };
            }
        }
        var markers = this.readRunMarkers();
        var held = markers[source];
        if (held) {
            if (held.run !== run) {
                if (held.state === 'running') {
                    return { ok: false, stamp: '', provenance: '', reason: 'another run holds this source' };
                }
            }
        }
        var stamp = new GlideDateTime().getValue();
        markers[source] = {
            source: source,
            provenance: mode,
            state: 'succeeded',
            stamp: stamp,
            run: run
        };
        this._writeRunMarkers(markers);
        var confirmed = this.readRunMarkers()[source];
        if (!confirmed) {
            return { ok: false, stamp: '', provenance: '', reason: 'the completion could not be written' };
        }
        if (confirmed.state !== 'succeeded') {
            return { ok: false, stamp: '', provenance: '', reason: 'the completion did not read back' };
        }
        if (confirmed.provenance !== mode) {
            return { ok: false, stamp: '', provenance: confirmed.provenance,
                reason: 'the provenance did not read back' };
        }
        return { ok: true, stamp: confirmed.stamp, provenance: confirmed.provenance, reason: '' };
    },

    /* Releases one source system's claim without recording a success, so the next run may
       take the source immediately. Prompt 4.0. */
    releaseRunLease: function (sourceSystem, runId) {
        var source = this._sourceToken(sourceSystem);
        var run = this._runToken(runId);
        if (source === '') {
            return false;
        }
        var markers = this.readRunMarkers();
        var held = markers[source];
        if (!held) {
            return false;
        }
        if (held.state !== 'running') {
            return false;
        }
        if (held.run !== run) {
            return false;
        }
        markers[source] = null;
        this._writeRunMarkers(markers);
        return this.readRunMarkers()[source] === null;
    },

    /* Returns true when a claim timestamp is older than the configured cadence, which is
       the age at which a claim left behind by an interrupted run may be taken over.
       Prompt 4.0. */
    _claimExpired: function (stamp) {
        var age = gs.dateDiff(String(stamp), new GlideDateTime().getValue(), true);
        var seconds = parseInt(age, 10);
        if (isNaN(seconds)) {
            return true;
        }
        return seconds >= this.getCadenceHours() * 3600;
    },

    /* Returns a run identifier reduced to the characters a marker entry may carry.
       Prompt 4.0. */
    _runToken: function (runId) {
        return String(runId === null || runId === undefined ? '' : runId)
            .trim().replace(/[^0-9A-Za-z_.-]/g, '').substring(0, 64);
    },

    /* Returns the provenance of the most recent completed run across both source systems,
       or an empty string when no run has completed. Prompt 4.0. */
    getLastRunProvenance: function () {
        var markers = this.readRunMarkers();
        if (markers.legacy !== '') {
            return markers.legacy;
        }
        var order = ['crunchbase', 'linkedin'];
        var latest = null;
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== order.length; i++) {
            var marker = markers[order[i]];
            if (!marker) {
                continue;
            }
            if (marker.state !== 'succeeded') {
                continue;
            }
            if (latest === null) {
                latest = marker;
                continue;
            }
            if (marker.stamp > latest.stamp) {
                latest = marker;
            }
        }
        if (latest === null) {
            return '';
        }
        return latest.provenance;
    },

    /* Returns the provenance of one source system's most recent completed run, or an
       empty string when that source has not completed a run. Prompt 4.0. */
    getRunProvenance: function (sourceSystem) {
        var marker = this.readRunMarkers()[this._sourceToken(sourceSystem)];
        if (!marker) {
            return '';
        }
        if (marker.state !== 'succeeded') {
            return '';
        }
        return marker.provenance;
    },

    /* Returns the default REST page size, at least 1. Prompt 3.0. */
    getDefaultLimit: function () {
        return this.getBoundedInt('rest.default_limit', 20, 1);
    },

    /* Returns the maximum REST page size, at least 1 and never below the default page size.
       Prompt 3.0. */
    getMaxLimit: function () {
        var maximum = this.getBoundedInt('rest.max_limit', 50, 1);
        var minimum = this.getDefaultLimit();
        if (this._isBelow(maximum, minimum)) {
            return minimum;
        }
        return maximum;
    },

    /* Returns the request budget per window, at least 1. Prompt 8.0. */
    getRateLimitRequests: function () {
        return this.getBoundedInt('rest.rate_limit_requests', 100, 1);
    },

    /* Returns the rate limit window length in seconds, at least 1. Prompt 8.0. */
    getRateLimitWindowSeconds: function () {
        return this.getBoundedInt('rest.rate_limit_window_seconds', 60, 1);
    },

    /* Returns the inclusion criteria location tokens. Prompt 1.1. */
    getInclusionLocationTokens: function () {
        var raw = String(this.get('inclusion.location_tokens', 'Boston,Cambridge, MA'));
        var parts = raw.split(',');
        var tokens = [];
        var buffer = '';
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== parts.length; i++) {
            var piece = parts[i].trim();
            if (piece.length === 2) {
                if (piece === piece.toUpperCase()) {
                    if (buffer !== '') {
                        tokens.push(buffer + ', ' + piece);
                        buffer = '';
                        continue;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (buffer !== '') {
                tokens.push(buffer);
            }
            buffer = piece;
        }
        if (buffer !== '') {
            tokens.push(buffer);
        }
        var cleaned = [];
        for (i = 0; i !== tokens.length; i++) {
            if (tokens[i] !== '') {
                cleaned.push(tokens[i]);
            }
        }
        if (cleaned.length === 0) {
            cleaned = ['Boston', 'Cambridge, MA'];
        }
        return cleaned;
    },

    /* Returns the Crunchbase API base URL, which is the version 4 data base path the
       Crunchbase flow calls. Prompt 4.0. */
    getCrunchbaseBaseUrl: function () {
        return this.get('crunchbase.base_url', 'https://api.crunchbase.com/api/v4');
    },

    /* Returns the LinkedIn API base URL, which is the versioned rest base path the
       LinkedIn flow calls. Prompt 4.0. */
    getLinkedinBaseUrl: function () {
        return this.get('linkedin.base_url', 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest');
    },

    /* Returns the LinkedIn API version for the LinkedIn-Version request header, in the
       provider's YYYYMM form. Prompt 4.0. */
    getLinkedinApiVersion: function () {
        return this.LINKEDIN_API_VERSION;
    },

    /* Returns the timestamp of the last completed ingestion run for one source system, or
       the empty string when that source has not completed a run. This is the value the
       cadence guard compares against. Prompt 4.0. */
    getLastSuccessAt: function (sourceSystem) {
        var marker = this.readRunMarkers()[this._sourceToken(sourceSystem)];
        if (!marker) {
            return '';
        }
        if (marker.state !== 'succeeded') {
            return '';
        }
        return marker.stamp;
    },

    /* Returns one of the two source system tokens, or the empty string for anything else.
       Prompt 4.0. */
    _sourceToken: function (sourceSystem) {
        var source = String(sourceSystem === null ? '' : sourceSystem).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (source === 'crunchbase') {
            return source;
        }
        if (source === 'linkedin') {
            return source;
        }
        return '';
    },

    /* Returns the configured log level. A value outside the debug, info, warn and error choice
       list resolves to info. Prompt 8.0. */
    getLoggingLevel: function () {
        var level = String(this.get('logging.level', 'info')).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (this.LOG_LEVELS.indexOf(level) === -1) {
            return 'info';
        }
        return level;
    },

    /* Returns the LOG_LEVELS member a severity names. An unrecognised severity resolves to
       error, the most severe member, so a write whose severity cannot be classified is
       never suppressed. This is the one severity policy in the application; every caller
       resolves a severity through it. Prompt 8.0. */
    normaliseSeverity: function (severity) {
        var candidate = String(severity === null ? '' : severity).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (this.LOG_LEVELS.indexOf(candidate) === -1) {
            return 'error';
        }
        return candidate;
    },

    /* Returns true when a write at the given severity is permitted by the configured log
       level. The severity is resolved through normaliseSeverity first. Prompt 8.0. */
    isLogLevelEnabled: function (severity) {
        var rank = this.LOG_LEVELS.indexOf(this.normaliseSeverity(severity));
        return !this._isBelow(rank, this.LOG_LEVELS.indexOf(this.getLoggingLevel()));
    },

    type: 'AppProperties'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>c4f1621bf0621985f01e0746f7331fa6</sys_id><sys_name>AppProperties</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.RestQueryHelper</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Parses, bounds and validates REST request parameters, path identifiers and create and update body values, including an https only URL allowlist, an email address allowlist, real calendar date checking and a maximum page depth. Implements prompt 3.0 pagination and prompt 8.0 error bodies.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>RestQueryHelper</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var RestQueryHelper = Class.create();
RestQueryHelper.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.props = new AppProperties();
        this.LOG = 'x_bst_startuptrk.RestQueryHelper';
        this.SYS_ID = /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/;
        this.WHOLE_NUMBER = /^[0-9]{1,9}$/;
        this.SIGNED_NUMBER = /^-?[0-9]{1,9}$/;
        this.AMOUNT = /^-?[0-9]{1,15}(\.[0-9]{1,2})?$/;
        this.ISO_DATE = /^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/;
        this.CONTROL = /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f\u200b-\u200f\u202a-\u202e\u2028\u2029\ufeff]/g;
        this.HTTPS_URL = new RegExp('^[Hh][Tt][Tt][Pp][Ss]:\\/\\/'
            + '[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?'
            + '(?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?)+'
            + '(?::[0-9]{1,5})?'
            + '(?:\\/[A-Za-z0-9\\-._~%!$&()*+,;=:@\\/?#\\[\\]]*)?$');
        this.EMAIL = new RegExp('^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]{1,64}@'
            + '[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?'
            + '(?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?)+$');
        this.URL_LIMIT = 255;
        this.EMAIL_LIMIT = 254;
        this.MONTH_LENGTHS = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31];
        this.MIN_YEAR = 1900;
        this.MAX_YEAR = 2999;
        this.TEXT_LIMIT = 100;
        this.DEFAULT_LIMIT_FLOOR = 20;
        this.MAX_LIMIT_FLOOR = 50;
        this.MAX_OFFSET = 10000;
    },

    /* Returns sysparm_limit bounded by the default and maximum page size properties.
       Implements prompt 3.0 pagination. */
    getLimit: function (request) {
        var maximum = this._positive(this.props.getMaxLimit(), this.MAX_LIMIT_FLOOR);
        var fallback = Math.min(this._positive(this.props.getDefaultLimit(),
            this.DEFAULT_LIMIT_FLOOR), maximum);
        var raw = this._param(request, 'sysparm_limit');
        if (!this.WHOLE_NUMBER.test(raw)) {
            return fallback;
        }
        var limit = parseInt(raw, 10);
        if (limit < 1) {
            return fallback;
        }
        return Math.min(limit, maximum);
    },

    /* Returns sysparm_offset bounded at zero and refused above MAX_OFFSET. An absent
       value yields zero; a supplied value that is not a whole number, or that exceeds
       MAX_OFFSET, is refused with the message the operation returns as a 400.
       Implements prompt 3.0 pagination and prompt 8.0 error bodies. */
    getOffset: function (request) {
        var raw = this._param(request, 'sysparm_offset');
        if (raw === '') {
            return { ok: true, value: 0, error: '' };
        }
        if (!this.WHOLE_NUMBER.test(raw)) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                value: 0,
                error: 'sysparm_offset must be a whole number between 0 and '
                    + this.MAX_OFFSET
            };
        }
        var offset = parseInt(raw, 10);
        if (offset > this.MAX_OFFSET) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                value: 0,
                error: 'sysparm_offset must not exceed ' + this.MAX_OFFSET
            };
        }
        return { ok: true, value: offset, error: '' };
    },

    /* Returns a trimmed, control character free, length bounded query parameter.
       Implements prompt 3.0 filter parameters. */
    getTextParam: function (request, name) {
        return this._text(this._param(request, name));
    },

    /* Returns a query parameter validated as a 32 character record identifier.
       Implements prompt 3.0 filter parameters. */
    getSysIdParam: function (request, name) {
        var raw = this._param(request, name);
        if (raw === '') {
            return { ok: true, value: '', error: '' };
        }
        if (!this.isSysId(raw)) {
            return { ok: false, value: '', error: name + ' must be a 32 character sys_id' };
        }
        return { ok: true, value: raw, error: '' };
    },

    /* Returns a query parameter validated as a member of a choice list.
       Implements prompt 3.0 filter parameters. */
    getChoiceParam: function (request, name, allowed) {
        var raw = this._param(request, name);
        if (raw === '') {
            return { ok: true, value: '', error: '' };
        }
        if (!this._member(raw, allowed)) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                value: '',
                error: name + ' must be one of ' + allowed.join(', ')
            };
        }
        return { ok: true, value: raw, error: '' };
    },

    /* Returns a path parameter validated as a 32 character record identifier.
       Implements prompt 3.0 record addressing. */
    getPathSysId: function (request, name) {
        var params = request ? request.pathParams : null;
        var raw = params ? params[name] : '';
        raw = this._text(raw);
        if (raw === '') {
            return { ok: false, value: '', error: name + ' is required' };
        }
        if (!this.isSysId(raw)) {
            return { ok: false, value: '', error: name + ' must be a 32 character sys_id' };
        }
        return { ok: true, value: raw, error: '' };
    },

    /* Returns true when a yyyy-MM-dd value names a day that exists in the Gregorian
       calendar. A value such as 2026-13-45 or 2027-02-29 returns false.
       Implements prompt 3.0 create and update validation. */
    isCalendarDate: function (value) {
        var parts = String(value).split('-');
        if (parts.length !== 3) {
            return false;
        }
        var year = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
        var month = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
        var day = parseInt(parts[2], 10);
        if (isNaN(year)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (isNaN(month)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (isNaN(day)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (year < this.MIN_YEAR) {
            return false;
        }
        if (year > this.MAX_YEAR) {
            return false;
        }
        if (month < 1) {
            return false;
        }
        if (month > 12) {
            return false;
        }
        if (day < 1) {
            return false;
        }
        return day <= this._daysInMonth(year, month);
    },

    /* Returns the number of days in one month, honouring the Gregorian leap year rule. */
    _daysInMonth: function (year, month) {
        if (month !== 2) {
            return this.MONTH_LENGTHS[month - 1];
        }
        if (year % 400 === 0) {
            return 29;
        }
        if (year % 100 === 0) {
            return 28;
        }
        if (year % 4 === 0) {
            return 29;
        }
        return 28;
    },

    /* Returns true when a value has the shape of a record identifier. */
    isSysId: function (value) {
        if (value === null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (value === undefined) {
            return false;
        }
        return this.SYS_ID.test(String(value).trim());
    },

    /* Validates a request body against a field specification and returns the values to
       write. Implements prompt 3.0 create and update validation and prompt 8.0 error
       bodies. Each specification entry declares field, type and, per type, choices,
       table, max and mandatory. */
    validateBody: function (payload, spec, requireMandatory) {
        var values = {};
        var supplied = 0;
        var i = 0;
        if (!payload) {
            return { ok: false, values: values, error: 'Request body is required' };
        }
        for (i = 0; i !== spec.length; i++) {
            var rule = spec[i];
            var raw = payload[rule.field];
            if (raw === undefined) {
                if (requireMandatory) {
                    if (rule.mandatory) {
                        return {
                            ok: false,
                            values: values,
                            error: rule.field + ' is required'
                        };
                    }
                }
                continue;
            }
            var checked = this._coerce(rule, raw);
            if (!checked.ok) {
                return { ok: false, values: values, error: checked.error };
            }
            if (rule.mandatory) {
                if (checked.value === '') {
                    return {
                        ok: false,
                        values: values,
                        error: rule.field + ' is required'
                    };
                }
            }
            values[rule.field] = checked.value;
            supplied = supplied + 1;
        }
        if (supplied === 0) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                values: values,
                error: 'Request body carries no writable field'
            };
        }
        return { ok: true, values: values, error: '' };
    },

    /* Returns true when a value is an absolute https URL drawn from the allowlisted
       character set and no longer than URL_LIMIT. This is the URL rule the create and
       update body validation applies, exposed so the ingestion boundary applies the same
       one. Implements prompt 3.0 create and update validation and prompt 4.0. */
    isHttpsUrl: function (value) {
        var text = this._normalise(value);
        if (text === '') {
            return false;
        }
        if (text.length > this.URL_LIMIT) {
            return false;
        }
        return this.HTTPS_URL.test(text);
    },

    /* Returns true when a value is an email address drawn from the allowlisted character
       set and no longer than EMAIL_LIMIT. This is the address rule the create and update
       body validation applies, exposed so the ingestion boundary applies the same one.
       Implements prompt 3.0 create and update validation and prompt 4.0. */
    isEmailAddress: function (value) {
        var text = this._normalise(value);
        if (text === '') {
            return false;
        }
        if (text.length > this.EMAIL_LIMIT) {
            return false;
        }
        return this.EMAIL.test(text);
    },

    /* Returns true when a record exists and is readable by the caller.
       Implements prompt 3.0 reference validation on the secured read path. */
    referenceExists: function (table, sysId) {
        if (!this.isSysId(sysId)) {
            return false;
        }
        var target = new GlideRecordSecure(table);
        return target.get(sysId);
    },

    /* Returns the length a value of one field may not exceed: the column's own declared
       maximum, bounded by the hard limit of its validation type where the type has one.
       The field specific maximum is therefore always the authoritative one, and a field
       that declares none falls back to the general text bound. */
    _ceiling: function (rule) {
        var limit = 0;
        if (rule.type === 'url') {
            limit = this.URL_LIMIT;
        }
        if (rule.type === 'email') {
            limit = this.EMAIL_LIMIT;
        }
        if (!rule.max) {
            return limit ? limit : this.TEXT_LIMIT;
        }
        if (!limit) {
            return rule.max;
        }
        return Math.min(rule.max, limit);
    },

    _coerce: function (rule, raw) {
        var type = rule.type;
        if (type === 'boolean') {
            return this._boolean(rule, raw);
        }
        var ceiling = this._ceiling(rule);
        if (this._normalise(raw).length > ceiling) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                value: '',
                error: rule.field + ' exceeds ' + ceiling + ' characters'
            };
        }
        var value = this._text(raw, ceiling);
        if (value === '') {
            return { ok: true, value: '', error: '' };
        }
        if (type === 'string') {
            return { ok: true, value: value, error: '' };
        }
        if (type === 'url') {
            if (!this.HTTPS_URL.test(value)) {
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    value: '',
                    error: rule.field + ' must be an absolute https URL'
                };
            }
            return { ok: true, value: value, error: '' };
        }
        if (type === 'email') {
            if (!this.EMAIL.test(value)) {
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    value: '',
                    error: rule.field + ' must be an email address'
                };
            }
            return { ok: true, value: value, error: '' };
        }
        if (type === 'choice') {
            if (!this._member(value, rule.choices)) {
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    value: '',
                    error: rule.field + ' must be one of ' + rule.choices.join(', ')
                };
            }
            return { ok: true, value: this._canonical(value, rule.choices), error: '' };
        }
        if (type === 'multichoice') {
            return this._multichoice(rule, value);
        }
        if (type === 'integer') {
            if (!this.SIGNED_NUMBER.test(value)) {
                return { ok: false, value: '', error: rule.field + ' must be a whole number' };
            }
            return { ok: true, value: value, error: '' };
        }
        if (type === 'currency') {
            if (!this.AMOUNT.test(value)) {
                return { ok: false, value: '', error: rule.field + ' must be an amount' };
            }
            return { ok: true, value: value, error: '' };
        }
        if (type === 'date') {
            if (!this.ISO_DATE.test(value)) {
                return { ok: false, value: '', error: rule.field + ' must be a yyyy-MM-dd date' };
            }
            if (!this.isCalendarDate(value)) {
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    value: '',
                    error: rule.field + ' must be a date that exists in the calendar'
                };
            }
            return { ok: true, value: value, error: '' };
        }
        if (type === 'reference') {
            if (!this.isSysId(value)) {
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    value: '',
                    error: rule.field + ' must be a 32 character sys_id'
                };
            }
            if (!this.referenceExists(rule.table, value)) {
                gs.info('[' + this.LOG + '] reference ' + value + ' supplied for field '
                    + rule.field + ' is not a readable ' + rule.table + ' record');
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    value: '',
                    error: rule.field + ' does not name a readable record'
                };
            }
            return { ok: true, value: value, error: '' };
        }
        return { ok: false, value: '', error: rule.field + ' has an unsupported type' };
    },

    _boolean: function (rule, raw) {
        if (raw === true) {
            return { ok: true, value: 'true', error: '' };
        }
        if (raw === false) {
            return { ok: true, value: 'false', error: '' };
        }
        var text = this._text(raw).toLowerCase();
        if (text === 'true') {
            return { ok: true, value: 'true', error: '' };
        }
        if (text === '1') {
            return { ok: true, value: 'true', error: '' };
        }
        if (text === 'false') {
            return { ok: true, value: 'false', error: '' };
        }
        if (text === '0') {
            return { ok: true, value: 'false', error: '' };
        }
        return { ok: false, value: '', error: rule.field + ' must be true or false' };
    },

    _multichoice: function (rule, value) {
        var parts = value.split(',');
        var picked = [];
        var seen = {};
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== parts.length; i++) {
            var token = this._text(parts[i]);
            if (token === '') {
                continue;
            }
            if (!this._member(token, rule.choices)) {
                return {
                    ok: false,
                    value: '',
                    error: rule.field + ' must contain only ' + rule.choices.join(', ')
                };
            }
            var canonical = this._canonical(token, rule.choices);
            if (seen[canonical]) {
                continue;
            }
            seen[canonical] = true;
            picked.push(canonical);
        }
        return { ok: true, value: picked.join(','), error: '' };
    },

    _member: function (value, allowed) {
        var i = 0;
        if (!allowed) {
            return false;
        }
        for (i = 0; i !== allowed.length; i++) {
            if (String(value).toLowerCase() === String(allowed[i]).toLowerCase()) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    },

    _canonical: function (value, allowed) {
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== allowed.length; i++) {
            if (String(value).toLowerCase() === String(allowed[i]).toLowerCase()) {
                return allowed[i];
            }
        }
        return String(value);
    },

    _positive: function (value, floor) {
        var parsed = parseInt(value, 10);
        if (isNaN(parsed)) {
            return floor;
        }
        if (parsed < 1) {
            return floor;
        }
        return parsed;
    },

    /* Returns a value trimmed and stripped of control characters at its full length,
       which is the form every length check is applied to. */
    _normalise: function (value) {
        if (value === null) {
            return '';
        }
        if (value === undefined) {
            return '';
        }
        return String(value).replace(this.CONTROL, ' ').trim();
    },

    _text: function (value, max) {
        var text = this._normalise(value);
        var ceiling = this.TEXT_LIMIT;
        if (max) {
            ceiling = max;
        }
        if (text.length > ceiling) {
            text = text.substring(0, ceiling);
        }
        return text;
    },

    _param: function (request, name) {
        if (!request) {
            return '';
        }
        var params = request.queryParams;
        if (!params) {
            return '';
        }
        var value = params[name];
        if (value === null) {
            return '';
        }
        if (value === undefined) {
            return '';
        }
        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            if (value.length === 0) {
                return '';
            }
            value = value[0];
        }
        return String(value).trim();
    },

    type: 'RestQueryHelper'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>717164a8c4c3ac69c507da0a8a6d2e79</sys_id><sys_name>RestQueryHelper</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.RestResponseBuilder</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Builds the exact total_count pagination envelope, omits fields the caller may not read, counts the filtered set with one aggregate query and reports a table level read denial, enforces the JSON only request contract and the scoped role endpoint authorisation, and returns the prompt 8.0 error bodies.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>RestResponseBuilder</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var RestResponseBuilder = Class.create();
RestResponseBuilder.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.LOG = 'x_bst_startuptrk.RestResponseBuilder';
        this.PUBLIC_SERVER_ERROR = 'Internal server error';
        this.JSON_MEDIA_TYPE = 'application/json';
        this.JSON_BODY_REQUIRED = 'Request body must be application/json';
        this.ROLE_ADMIN = 'x_bst_startuptrk.admin';
        this.ROLE_PREMIUM = 'x_bst_startuptrk.premium_user';
        this.ROLE_USER = 'x_bst_startuptrk.user';
        this.READ_FORBIDDEN = 'Caller holds no Boston Startup Tracker role';
        this.WRITE_FORBIDDEN = 'Caller holds no Boston Startup Tracker administrator role';
        this.COUNT_DENIED = 'Caller may not read this resource';
        this.CONTROL = /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f\u200b-\u200f\u202a-\u202e\u2028\u2029\ufeff]/g;
        this.ADDRESS = /[^\s]*@[^\s]*/g;
        this.LOCATOR = /[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:\/\/[^\s]*/g;
        this.REDACTED = '(redacted)';
        this.LOG_VALUE_LIMIT = 400;
        this.props = new AppProperties();
    },

    /* Serialises one record, omitting every field the caller may not read.
       Implements prompt 3.0 premium field omission. */
    serialize: function (record, fields) {
        var out = {};
        out.sys_id = record.getUniqueValue();
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== fields.length; i++) {
            var field = fields[i];
            if (!this.canRead(record, field)) {
                continue;
            }
            out[field] = this.valueOf(record, field);
        }
        return out;
    },

    /* Returns true only when the caller passes the field level read check. */
    canRead: function (record, field) {
        var element = record.getElement(field);
        if (!element) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!element.canRead()) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    },

    /* Returns a JSON friendly value for one readable element. */
    valueOf: function (record, field) {
        var element = record.getElement(field);
        var descriptor = element.getED();
        var type = String(descriptor.getInternalType());
        if (type === 'reference') {
            var referenced = record.getValue(field);
            if (!referenced) {
                return null;
            }
            return {
                value: referenced,
                display_value: element.getDisplayValue()
            };
        }
        if (type === 'boolean') {
            return String(record.getValue(field)) === '1';
        }
        if (type === 'integer') {
            var whole = parseInt(record.getValue(field), 10);
            if (isNaN(whole)) {
                return null;
            }
            return whole;
        }
        if (type === 'currency') {
            var money = record.getValue(field);
            if (!money) {
                return null;
            }
            return String(money);
        }
        var plain = record.getValue(field);
        if (plain === null) {
            return null;
        }
        return String(plain);
    },

    /* Builds the paginated envelope carrying the exact total_count of the filtered set.
       Implements prompt 3.0 total_count. */
    page: function (rows, totalCount, limit, offset) {
        return {
            result: rows,
            total_count: totalCount,
            limit: limit,
            offset: offset
        };
    },

    /* Returns the exact number of records matching the conditions the result set
       applies, and reports a read denial instead of answering zero. The gate is the
       caller holding at least one of the three application roles. The count is then one
       aggregate query. Implements prompt 2.0 role model and prompt 3.0 total_count. */
    countState: function (table, applyConditions) {
        if (!this.hasAnyAppRole()) {
            return { total: 0, denied: true };
        }
        var counted = new GlideAggregate(table);
        if (applyConditions) {
            applyConditions(counted);
        }
        counted.addAggregate('COUNT');
        counted.query();
        if (!counted.next()) {
            return { total: 0, denied: false };
        }
        var total = parseInt(counted.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10);
        if (isNaN(total)) {
            total = 0;
        }
        return { total: total, denied: false };
    },

    /* Writes the forbidden body when countState reported a table level read denial and
       returns true. Implements prompt 2.0 and prompt 3.0 endpoint authorisation. */
    rejectDeniedCount: function (response, counted) {
        if (!counted) {
            return false;
        }
        if (counted.denied !== true) {
            return false;
        }
        this.forbidden(response, this.COUNT_DENIED);
        return true;
    },

    /* Returns countState's total only, answering zero on a read denial. A caller facing
       count uses countState with rejectDeniedCount instead.
       Implements prompt 3.0 total_count. */
    countWith: function (table, applyConditions) {
        return this.countState(table, applyConditions).total;
    },

    /* Returns the exact size of every group a column takes on a table, as an object keyed
       on the stored value, from one grouped aggregate and behind the same table level read
       gate as countState. A group the data does not populate is absent from the result
       rather than present at zero, so a caller reads the result through its own closed
       label list and defaults what is missing. Implements prompt 3.0 counting. */
    countByGroup: function (table, field, applyConditions) {
        var sizes = {};
        if (!this.hasAnyAppRole()) {
            return sizes;
        }
        var grouped = new GlideAggregate(table);
        if (applyConditions) {
            applyConditions(grouped);
        }
        grouped.addAggregate('COUNT', field);
        grouped.groupBy(field);
        grouped.query();
        while (grouped.next()) {
            var key = grouped.getValue(field);
            if (!key) {
                key = '';
            }
            var size = parseInt(grouped.getAggregate('COUNT', field), 10);
            if (isNaN(size)) {
                size = 0;
            }
            sizes[key] = size;
        }
        return sizes;
    },

    /* Returns true when the caller holds at least one of the three application roles.
       Implements prompt 2.0 role model. */
    hasAnyAppRole: function () {
        if (gs.hasRole(this.ROLE_ADMIN)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (gs.hasRole(this.ROLE_PREMIUM)) {
            return true;
        }
        return gs.hasRole(this.ROLE_USER);
    },

    /* Writes the forbidden body. Implements the prompt 8.0 error body shape. */
    forbidden: function (response, message) {
        response.setStatus(403);
        response.setBody({ error: message });
    },

    /* Rejects a read request from a caller holding none of the three application roles.
       Returns true when the request was rejected. Implements prompt 2.0 and prompt 3.0
       endpoint authorisation. */
    rejectUnauthorisedRead: function (response) {
        if (this.hasAnyAppRole()) {
            return false;
        }
        this.forbidden(response, this.READ_FORBIDDEN);
        return true;
    },

    /* Rejects a create, update or delete request from a caller without the application
       administrator role. Returns true when the request was rejected. Implements
       prompt 2.0 and prompt 3.0 endpoint authorisation. */
    rejectUnauthorisedWrite: function (response) {
        if (gs.hasRole(this.ROLE_ADMIN)) {
            return false;
        }
        this.forbidden(response, this.WRITE_FORBIDDEN);
        return true;
    },

    /* Returns the declared body media type of one request, lower cased and stripped of
       parameters and whitespace. Implements prompt 3.0 JSON only request contract. */
    bodyMediaType: function (request) {
        var supplied = '';
        if (request) {
            if (request.getHeader) {
                supplied = request.getHeader('content-type');
            }
        }
        if (supplied === null) {
            supplied = '';
        }
        if (supplied === undefined) {
            supplied = '';
        }
        return String(supplied).split(';')[0].toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, '');
    },

    /* Writes the unsupported media type body. Implements prompt 3.0 JSON only request
       contract and the prompt 8.0 error body shape. */
    unsupportedMediaType: function (response, message) {
        response.setStatus(415);
        response.setBody({ error: message });
    },

    /* Rejects a body bearing request that does not declare application/json. Returns
       true when the request was rejected.
       Implements prompt 3.0 JSON only request contract. */
    rejectNonJsonBody: function (request, response) {
        if (this.bodyMediaType(request) === this.JSON_MEDIA_TYPE) {
            return false;
        }
        this.unsupportedMediaType(response, this.JSON_BODY_REQUIRED);
        return true;
    },

    /* Writes the not found body. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    notFound: function (response, message) {
        response.setStatus(404);
        response.setBody({ error: message });
    },

    /* Writes the bad request body. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    badRequest: function (response, message) {
        response.setStatus(400);
        response.setBody({ error: message });
    },

    /* Writes the generic server error body carrying a correlation identifier and logs
       the caught message and stack trace, both sanitised by _logSafe, against the same
       identifier when logging.level permits an error line. The status and the body are
       written whether or not the line is. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    serverError: function (response, error) {
        var errorId = this.errorId();
        var message = '';
        var trace = '';
        if (error) {
            if (error.message) {
                message = String(error.message);
            }
            if (error.stack) {
                trace = String(error.stack);
            }
        }
        if (message === '') {
            message = String(error);
        }
        if (this.props.isLogLevelEnabled('error')) {
            gs.error('[' + this.LOG + '] error_id=' + errorId
                + ' message="' + this._logSafe(message)
                + '" stack="' + this._logSafe(trace) + '"');
        }
        response.setStatus(500);
        response.setBody({
            error: this.PUBLIC_SERVER_ERROR + ' (error_id ' + errorId + ')'
        });
    },

    /* Returns a short correlation identifier for one failed request. Prompt 8.0. */
    errorId: function () {
        return String(gs.generateGUID()).replace(/-/g, '').substring(0, 12);
    },

    /* Returns one value that is safe to write into a quoted log field: control
       characters are replaced, a double quote becomes a single quote, an address like or
       locator like substring is redacted, whitespace is collapsed, and the result is
       capped at LOG_VALUE_LIMIT characters with the truncation marked.
       Implements prompt 8.0 logging. */
    _logSafe: function (value) {
        if (value === null) {
            return '';
        }
        if (value === undefined) {
            return '';
        }
        var text = String(value).replace(this.CONTROL, ' ').replace(/"/g, "'");
        text = text.replace(this.ADDRESS, this.REDACTED);
        text = text.replace(this.LOCATOR, this.REDACTED);
        text = text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
        text = text.replace(/^ /, '').replace(/ $/, '');
        if (text.length > this.LOG_VALUE_LIMIT) {
            text = text.substring(0, this.LOG_VALUE_LIMIT) + '...(truncated)';
        }
        return text;
    },

    type: 'RestResponseBuilder'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>877edd48994511bd28a906ba3566b3b7</sys_id><sys_name>RestResponseBuilder</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.RateLimitService</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Per caller fixed window request accounting keyed on a unique caller, resource and window column, applied with an atomic increment, a read back total, a bounded retry and duplicate summing. Answers the prompt 8.0 rate limit response body with a computed retry_after when the caller is over budget, and the prompt 8.0 failure body at status 500 when the counted write could not be persisted, so status 429 reports quota exhaustion only. Prunes closed windows. Implements prompt 8.0.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>RateLimitService</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var RateLimitService = Class.create();
RateLimitService.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.TABLE = 'x_bst_startuptrk_rate_limit_counter';
        this.LOG = 'x_bst_startuptrk.RateLimitService';
        this.props = new AppProperties();
        this.BUDGET_FLOOR = 100;
        this.WINDOW_FLOOR = 60;
        this.MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;
        this.KEY_LIMIT = 200;
        this.ACCOUNTING_UNAVAILABLE = 'Rate limit accounting could not be persisted';
    },

    /* Returns the composite uniqueness key for one caller, resource and window. The
       window_key column is declared unique. Implements prompt 8.0 rate limiting. */
    windowKey: function (caller, apiResource, windowStart) {
        var bucket = this._epochSeconds(windowStart);
        var key = String(caller) + '|' + String(apiResource) + '|' + String(bucket);
        if (key.length > this.KEY_LIMIT) {
            key = key.substring(0, this.KEY_LIMIT);
        }
        return key;
    },

    /* Records one request and reports whether the caller is over budget. The counted
       write is an atomic increment under the unique window key, the count is read back
       after the write, and duplicate rows carrying one key are summed.
       Implements prompt 8.0 rate limiting. */
    consume: function (apiResource) {
        var budget = this._positive(this.props.getRateLimitRequests(), this.BUDGET_FLOOR);
        var windowSeconds = this._positive(this.props.getRateLimitWindowSeconds(),
            this.WINDOW_FLOOR);
        var caller = gs.getUserID();
        var windowStart = this._windowStart(windowSeconds);
        var key = this.windowKey(caller, apiResource, windowStart);
        var attempts = 0;
        var applied = { count: 0, persisted: false, retry: true };

        while (attempts !== this.MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
            attempts = attempts + 1;
            applied = this._apply(key, caller, apiResource, windowStart);
            if (applied.persisted) {
                break;
            }
            if (!applied.retry) {
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!applied.persisted) {
            gs.error('[' + this.LOG + '] counter write for window ' + key
                + ' did not persist after ' + attempts
                + ' attempt(s); the request is refused');
        }

        return {
            exceeded: applied.count > budget,
            count: applied.count,
            budget: budget,
            persisted: applied.persisted,
            attempts: attempts,
            window_key: key,
            retry_after: this.retryAfter(windowStart, windowSeconds)
        };
    },

    /* Applies one counted request to the current window row, creating it when absent.
       Reports the resulting count, whether the write persisted and whether a retry may
       resolve a concurrent write. Implements prompt 8.0 rate limiting. */
    _apply: function (key, caller, apiResource, windowStart) {
        var rows = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
        rows.addQuery('window_key', key);
        rows.orderBy('sys_id');
        rows.query();
        var firstId = '';
        var total = 0;
        var duplicates = 0;
        while (rows.next()) {
            var value = parseInt(rows.getValue('request_count'), 10);
            if (isNaN(value)) {
                value = 0;
            }
            if (firstId === '') {
                firstId = rows.getUniqueValue();
            } else {
                duplicates = duplicates + 1;
            }
            total = total + value;
        }

        if (firstId === '') {
            return this._create(key, caller, apiResource, windowStart);
        }
        if (duplicates !== 0) {
            gs.error('[' + this.LOG + '] window ' + key + ' carries ' + (duplicates + 1)
                + ' counter rows; every count was summed for this decision');
        }
        return this._increment(firstId, key, total, duplicates);
    },

    /* Inserts the first counter row for one window key. A rejected insert is a lost race
       for the unique key and is reported as retryable.
       Implements prompt 8.0 rate limiting. */
    _create: function (key, caller, apiResource, windowStart) {
        var fresh = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
        fresh.initialize();
        fresh.setValue('window_key', key);
        fresh.setValue('caller', caller);
        fresh.setValue('api_resource', apiResource);
        fresh.setValue('window_start', windowStart.getValue());
        fresh.setValue('request_count', 1);
        if (!fresh.insert()) {
            gs.warn('[' + this.LOG + '] counter insert for window ' + key
                + ' was rejected; retrying against the existing row');
            return { count: 1, persisted: false, retry: true };
        }
        return { count: 1, persisted: true, retry: false };
    },

    /* Adds one to the counter row with the database's own atomic increment, then reads
       the window total back, so the count this request decides on includes every
       increment applied concurrently with it. A row that has gone, or a rejected update,
       is reported as retryable. Implements prompt 8.0 rate limiting. */
    _increment: function (rowId, key, total, duplicates) {
        var row = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
        if (!row.get(rowId)) {
            return { count: total + 1, persisted: false, retry: true };
        }
        row.addValue('request_count', 1);
        if (!row.update()) {
            gs.error('[' + this.LOG + '] counter update for window ' + key
                + ' was rejected');
            return { count: total + 1, persisted: false, retry: true };
        }
        return {
            count: this._observed(key, total + 1),
            persisted: true,
            retry: false,
            duplicates: duplicates
        };
    },

    /* Returns the summed request_count of every row carrying one window key, read after
       the counted write. Falls back to the supplied value when the read yields no usable
       total. Implements prompt 8.0 rate limiting. */
    _observed: function (key, fallback) {
        var counted = new GlideAggregate(this.TABLE);
        counted.addQuery('window_key', key);
        counted.addAggregate('SUM', 'request_count');
        counted.query();
        if (!counted.next()) {
            return fallback;
        }
        var total = parseInt(counted.getAggregate('SUM', 'request_count'), 10);
        if (isNaN(total)) {
            return fallback;
        }
        if (total < fallback) {
            return fallback;
        }
        return total;
    },

    /* Returns the seconds remaining in the current window, with a floor of one.
       Implements prompt 8.0. */
    retryAfter: function (windowStart, windowSeconds) {
        var expiry = new GlideDateTime(windowStart.getValue());
        expiry.addSeconds(windowSeconds);
        var remaining = gs.dateDiff(new GlideDateTime().getValue(), expiry.getValue(), true);
        var seconds = parseInt(remaining, 10);
        if (isNaN(seconds)) {
            return windowSeconds;
        }
        return Math.max(seconds, 1);
    },

    /* Returns the prompt 8.0 rate limit response body. */
    body: function (retryAfter) {
        return {
            error: 'rate_limit_exceeded',
            retry_after: retryAfter
        };
    },

    /* Applies the rate limit to one request and returns true when the request was
       rejected. A caller over budget is refused with status 429 and the prompt 8.0 rate
       limit body. A counted write that did not persist is refused with status 500 and the
       prompt 8.0 failure body. Status 429 reports quota exhaustion only.
       Implements prompt 8.0. */
    reject: function (response, apiResource) {
        var state = this.consume(apiResource);
        if (!state.persisted) {
            new RestResponseBuilder().serverError(response,
                new Error(this.ACCOUNTING_UNAVAILABLE + ' for window ' + state.window_key
                    + ' after ' + state.attempts + ' attempt(s)'));
            return true;
        }
        if (!state.exceeded) {
            return false;
        }
        response.setStatus(429);
        response.setHeader('Retry-After', String(state.retry_after));
        response.setBody(this.body(state.retry_after));
        return true;
    },

    /* Removes every counter row whose window start is older than retainSeconds, counted
       with one aggregate query and removed with one bulk delete, then re-counts the set
       so any row the delete did not remove is reported. Returns the number of rows
       actually removed. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    prune: function (retainSeconds) {
        var retain = this._positive(retainSeconds, this.WINDOW_FLOOR);
        var cutoff = new GlideDateTime();
        cutoff.addSeconds(-retain);
        var boundary = cutoff.getValue();
        var before = this._countClosed(boundary);
        if (before !== 0) {
            var stale = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
            stale.addQuery('window_start', '<', boundary);
            stale.deleteMultiple();
        }
        var failed = this._countClosed(boundary);
        if (failed !== 0) {
            gs.error('[' + this.LOG + '] ' + failed
                + ' closed window row(s) could not be deleted');
        }
        return (before - failed) + this._pruneUnkeyed();
    },

    /* Counts the counter rows whose window started before an absolute boundary with one
       aggregate query. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    _countClosed: function (boundary) {
        var counted = new GlideAggregate(this.TABLE);
        counted.addQuery('window_start', '<', boundary);
        counted.addAggregate('COUNT');
        counted.query();
        if (!counted.next()) {
            return 0;
        }
        var total = parseInt(counted.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10);
        if (isNaN(total)) {
            return 0;
        }
        return total;
    },

    /* Removes counter rows carrying no window key. Returns the number removed.
       Implements prompt 8.0 rate limiting. */
    _pruneUnkeyed: function () {
        var unkeyed = new GlideRecord(this.TABLE);
        unkeyed.addNullQuery('window_key');
        unkeyed.query();
        var removed = 0;
        while (unkeyed.next()) {
            if (unkeyed.deleteRecord()) {
                removed = removed + 1;
            } else {
                gs.error('[' + this.LOG + '] unkeyed counter row '
                    + unkeyed.getUniqueValue() + ' could not be deleted');
            }
        }
        return removed;
    },

    /* Returns whole seconds since the epoch for a date/time value or its string form. */
    _epochSeconds: function (value) {
        var text = value;
        if (value) {
            if (value.getValue) {
                text = value.getValue();
            }
        }
        var moment = new GlideDateTime(String(text));
        return Math.floor(moment.getNumericValue() / 1000);
    },

    _windowStart: function (windowSeconds) {
        var now = new GlideDateTime();
        var epoch = Math.floor(now.getNumericValue() / 1000);
        var bucket = epoch - (epoch % windowSeconds);
        var start = new GlideDateTime();
        start.setNumericValue(bucket * 1000);
        return start;
    },

    _positive: function (value, floor) {
        var parsed = parseInt(value, 10);
        if (isNaN(parsed)) {
            return floor;
        }
        if (parsed < 1) {
            return floor;
        }
        return parsed;
    },

    type: 'RateLimitService'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>1d2deda2fd91c1a00191c1d07a92615b</sys_id><sys_name>RateLimitService</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.StartupSearchService</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Builds the prompt 1.1 inclusion criteria query plan and applies the validated name, industry and location filters through the condition API for the REST list resource and the portal search widget.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>StartupSearchService</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var StartupSearchService = Class.create();
StartupSearchService.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.TABLE = 'x_bst_startuptrk_startup';
        this.props = new AppProperties();
        this.INDUSTRY = ['Fintech', 'Healthtech', 'SaaS', 'Consumer', 'Deeptech', 'Other'];
    },

    /* Reads and validates the caller supplied name, industry and location filters.
       Implements prompt 3.0 filter parameters. */
    readFilters: function (request, helper) {
        var industry = helper.getChoiceParam(request, 'industry', this.INDUSTRY);
        if (!industry.ok) {
            return { ok: false, error: industry.error, filters: null };
        }
        return {
            ok: true,
            error: '',
            filters: {
                name: helper.getTextParam(request, 'name'),
                industry: industry.value,
                location: helper.getTextParam(request, 'location')
            }
        };
    },

    /* Builds one query plan from the inclusion criteria and the validated caller
       filters. The same plan is applied to the result set and to the count, which is what
       makes total_count agree with the page contents.
       Implements prompt 1.1 and prompt 3.0. */
    buildPlan: function (filters, applyInclusion) {
        var plan = {
            inclusion: false,
            tokens: [],
            name: '',
            industry: '',
            location: ''
        };
        if (applyInclusion) {
            plan.inclusion = true;
            plan.tokens = this.props.getInclusionLocationTokens();
        }
        if (filters) {
            if (filters.name) {
                plan.name = String(filters.name);
            }
            if (filters.industry) {
                plan.industry = String(filters.industry);
            }
            if (filters.location) {
                plan.location = String(filters.location);
            }
        }
        return plan;
    },

    /* Applies one query plan to a GlideRecordSecure through the condition API.
       Implements prompt 1.1 inclusion criteria and prompt 3.0. */
    applyPlan: function (query, plan) {
        var i = 0;
        if (plan.inclusion) {
            query.addQuery('active', true);
            if (plan.tokens.length !== 0) {
                var location = query.addQuery('headquarters_location', 'CONTAINS',
                    plan.tokens[0]);
                for (i = 1; i !== plan.tokens.length; i++) {
                    location.addOrCondition('headquarters_location', 'CONTAINS',
                        plan.tokens[i]);
                }
            }
        }
        if (plan.name !== '') {
            query.addQuery('name', 'CONTAINS', plan.name);
        }
        if (plan.industry !== '') {
            query.addQuery('industry', plan.industry);
        }
        if (plan.location !== '') {
            query.addQuery('headquarters_location', 'CONTAINS', plan.location);
        }
        return query;
    },

    /* Returns an ACL respecting result set ordered by name then sys_id and positioned
       for iteration. Implements prompt 3.0 pagination and no ACL bypass. */
    search: function (plan, limit, offset) {
        var startups = new GlideRecordSecure(this.TABLE);
        this.applyPlan(startups, plan);
        startups.orderBy('name');
        startups.orderBy('sys_id');
        if (limit !== null) {
            startups.chooseWindow(offset, offset + limit);
            /* The exact total already came from the aggregate count, so the windowed
               query does not count its own result set. Implements prompt 3.0 pagination. */
            startups.setNoCount();
        }
        startups.query();
        return startups;
    },

    /* Returns true when the caller should see the inclusion filtered set.
       Implements prompt 1.1 admin visibility. */
    appliesInclusion: function () {
        if (gs.hasRole('x_bst_startuptrk.admin')) {
            return false;
        }
        if (gs.hasRole('admin')) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    },

    type: 'StartupSearchService'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>a2e07ba24219c51cbe8c1f6507127b65</sys_id><sys_name>StartupSearchService</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
