sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.InvestorPortfolioService</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Derives Investor portfolio_count as the distinct startups reached as lead or participating investor and stores it with a checked write, and rewrites the derived FundingRound participating_investors projection from the authoritative join table with a checked write. Implements prompt 1.4 and prompt 1.5.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>InvestorPortfolioService</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var InvestorPortfolioService = Class.create();
InvestorPortfolioService.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.INVESTOR = 'x_bst_startuptrk_investor';
        this.ROUND = 'x_bst_startuptrk_fundinground';
        this.LINK = 'x_bst_startuptrk_m2m_round_investor';
        this.BATCH_SIZE = 200;
        this.LOG = 'x_bst_startuptrk.InvestorPortfolioService';
        /* The declared max_length of the derived participating_investors column and the
           number of 32 character identifiers a comma separated list of that length holds.
           Implements prompt 1.5. */
        this.PROJECTION_LENGTH = 4000;
        this.PROJECTION_CAPACITY = Math.floor((this.PROJECTION_LENGTH + 1) / 33);
    },

    /* Counts the distinct startups reachable as lead investor or as a participating
       investor, unioning both paths before counting. Implements prompt 1.4. */
    countPortfolio: function (investorId) {
        return this._size(this._startupsForInvestor(investorId));
    },

    /* Returns the set of distinct startup identifiers one investor reaches, keyed so the
       two paths union without double counting. Each path is read with a grouped
       aggregate query returning one row per startup, and the participation path is read
       in batches of BATCH_SIZE. Implements prompt 1.4. */
    _startupsForInvestor: function (investorId) {
        var startupIds = {};
        if (!investorId) {
            return startupIds;
        }

        var led = new GlideAggregate(this.ROUND);
        led.addQuery('lead_investor', investorId);
        led.addNotNullQuery('startup');
        led.addAggregate('COUNT');
        led.groupBy('startup');
        led.query();
        while (led.next()) {
            var ledStartup = this._ref(led.getValue('startup'));
            if (ledStartup !== '') {
                startupIds[ledStartup] = true;
            }
        }

        var roundIds = [];
        var link = new GlideRecord(this.LINK);
        link.addQuery('investor', investorId);
        link.addNotNullQuery('funding_round');
        link.query();
        while (link.next()) {
            var linkedRound = this._ref(link.getValue('funding_round'));
            if (linkedRound !== '') {
                roundIds.push(linkedRound);
            }
        }

        var batches = this._batch(roundIds);
        var b = 0;
        for (b = 0; b !== batches.length; b++) {
            var joined = new GlideAggregate(this.ROUND);
            joined.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', batches[b].join(','));
            joined.addNotNullQuery('startup');
            joined.addAggregate('COUNT');
            joined.groupBy('startup');
            joined.query();
            while (joined.next()) {
                var joinedStartup = this._ref(joined.getValue('startup'));
                if (joinedStartup !== '') {
                    startupIds[joinedStartup] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        return startupIds;
    },

    /* Stores the derived count on one investor and reports whether the stored value
       now matches the derivation. Implements prompt 1.4. */
    recalculate: function (investorId) {
        if (!investorId) {
            return false;
        }
        var investor = new GlideRecord(this.INVESTOR);
        if (!investor.get(investorId)) {
            return false;
        }
        var derived = this.countPortfolio(investorId);
        if (String(investor.getValue('portfolio_count')) === String(derived)) {
            return true;
        }
        investor.setValue('portfolio_count', derived);
        if (!investor.update()) {
            gs.error('[' + this.LOG + '] portfolio_count ' + derived
                + ' could not be stored on investor ' + investorId);
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    },

    /* Recalculates only the investors named, de-duplicated, and logs any investor
       whose stored count could not be refreshed. Implements prompt 1.4. */
    recalculateMany: function (investorIds) {
        var seen = {};
        var i = 0;
        var done = 0;
        var stale = [];
        for (i = 0; i !== investorIds.length; i++) {
            var id = investorIds[i];
            if (!id) {
                continue;
            }
            id = String(id);
            if (seen[id]) {
                continue;
            }
            seen[id] = true;
            if (this.recalculate(id)) {
                done = done + 1;
            } else {
                stale.push(id);
            }
        }
        if (stale.length !== 0) {
            gs.error('[' + this.LOG + '] portfolio_count may be stale for investor(s) '
                + stale.join(' '));
        }
        return done;
    },

    /* Recalculates every investor for use after a bulk load. Reads the whole graph in
       two passes, then makes one streamed pass over the investors, writing only those
       whose stored value differs from the derived value. Returns the number of investors
       written. Implements prompt 1.4. */
    recalculateAll: function () {
        var sizes = this._portfolioSizes();
        var investor = new GlideRecord(this.INVESTOR);
        investor.query();
        var written = 0;
        while (investor.next()) {
            var derived = 0;
            var id = investor.getUniqueValue();
            if (sizes[id]) {
                derived = sizes[id];
            }
            if (String(investor.getValue('portfolio_count')) === String(derived)) {
                continue;
            }
            investor.setValue('portfolio_count', derived);
            if (!investor.update()) {
                gs.error('[' + this.LOG + '] portfolio_count ' + derived
                    + ' could not be stored on investor ' + id);
                continue;
            }
            written = written + 1;
        }
        return written;
    },

    /* Returns the derived portfolio size of every investor, built from one pass over the
       funding rounds and one pass over the join table. Neither pass is given an
       identifier list and neither runs per investor. Implements prompt 1.4. */
    _portfolioSizes: function () {
        var roundStartups = {};
        var reached = {};
        var investorId = '';
        var roundId = '';
        var startupId = '';

        var round = new GlideRecord(this.ROUND);
        round.addNotNullQuery('startup');
        round.query();
        while (round.next()) {
            roundId = round.getUniqueValue();
            startupId = this._ref(round.getValue('startup'));
            if (startupId === '') {
                continue;
            }
            roundStartups[roundId] = startupId;
            investorId = this._ref(round.getValue('lead_investor'));
            if (investorId === '') {
                continue;
            }
            if (!reached[investorId]) {
                reached[investorId] = {};
            }
            reached[investorId][startupId] = true;
        }

        var link = new GlideRecord(this.LINK);
        link.query();
        while (link.next()) {
            investorId = this._ref(link.getValue('investor'));
            roundId = this._ref(link.getValue('funding_round'));
            if (investorId === '') {
                continue;
            }
            if (!roundStartups[roundId]) {
                continue;
            }
            startupId = roundStartups[roundId];
            if (!reached[investorId]) {
                reached[investorId] = {};
            }
            reached[investorId][startupId] = true;
        }

        var sizes = {};
        var key = '';
        for (key in reached) {
            if (reached.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                sizes[key] = this._size(reached[key]);
            }
        }
        return sizes;
    },

    /* Returns a map of funding round identifier to that round's participating
       investors, read from the authoritative join table in one query per bounded batch
       of rounds and de-duplicated. Implements prompt 1.5. */
    participantsForRounds: function (roundIds) {
        var result = {};
        var wanted = [];
        var seen = {};
        var i = 0;
        if (!roundIds) {
            return result;
        }
        for (i = 0; i !== roundIds.length; i++) {
            var roundId = String(roundIds[i] ? roundIds[i] : '');
            if (roundId === '') {
                continue;
            }
            if (seen[roundId]) {
                continue;
            }
            seen[roundId] = true;
            wanted.push(roundId);
            result[roundId] = [];
        }
        var batches = this._batch(wanted);
        var b = 0;
        for (b = 0; b !== batches.length; b++) {
            var link = new GlideRecordSecure(this.LINK);
            link.addQuery('funding_round', 'IN', batches[b].join(','));
            link.orderBy('investor');
            link.query();
            while (link.next()) {
                var owner = String(link.getValue('funding_round'));
                var investorId = String(link.getValue('investor'));
                if (!result[owner]) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (investorId === '') {
                    continue;
                }
                if (this._carries(result[owner], investorId)) {
                    continue;
                }
                result[owner].push({
                    value: investorId,
                    display_value: link.investor.getDisplayValue()
                });
            }
        }
        return result;
    },

    /* Rewrites the derived FundingRound.participating_investors list from the
       authoritative join table, which is the only write target for participation. The
       projection write calls setWorkflow(false), so it does not re-enter the business rule
       that triggered it. A round linking more investors than the declared column length
       holds has its projection emptied and the overflow reported at error severity rather
       than stored in part. Implements prompt 1.5. */
    refreshRoundParticipants: function (roundId) {
        if (!roundId) {
            return false;
        }
        var round = new GlideRecord(this.ROUND);
        if (!round.get(roundId)) {
            return false;
        }
        var entries = this.participantsForRounds([roundId])[roundId];
        var ids = [];
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== entries.length; i++) {
            ids.push(entries[i].value);
        }
        var derived = ids.join(',');
        if (derived.length > this.PROJECTION_LENGTH) {
            gs.error('[' + this.LOG + '] funding round ' + roundId + ' links '
                + ids.length + ' investors and the derived participating_investors'
                + ' column holds ' + this.PROJECTION_CAPACITY
                + '; the projection was emptied rather than stored in part, and'
                + ' x_bst_startuptrk_m2m_round_investor remains the complete record');
            derived = '';
        }
        if (String(round.getValue('participating_investors')) === derived) {
            return true;
        }
        round.setValue('participating_investors', derived);
        round.setWorkflow(false);
        if (!round.update()) {
            gs.error('[' + this.LOG + '] participating_investors could not be stored on'
                + ' funding round ' + roundId
                + '; x_bst_startuptrk_m2m_round_investor remains the complete record');
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    },

    /* Links one investor to one funding round, returning the existing join row when the
       pair is already present. Implements prompt 1.5. */
    linkInvestorToRound: function (roundId, investorId) {
        if (!roundId) {
            return '';
        }
        if (!investorId) {
            return '';
        }
        var existing = new GlideRecord(this.LINK);
        existing.addQuery('funding_round', roundId);
        existing.addQuery('investor', investorId);
        existing.setLimit(1);
        existing.query();
        if (existing.next()) {
            return existing.getUniqueValue();
        }
        var link = new GlideRecord(this.LINK);
        link.initialize();
        link.setValue('funding_round', roundId);
        link.setValue('investor', investorId);
        return link.insert();
    },

    /* Returns a reference value as a plain string, normalising an unset reference to the
       empty string. */
    _ref: function (value) {
        if (!value) {
            return '';
        }
        var text = String(value);
        if (text === 'null') {
            return '';
        }
        if (text === 'undefined') {
            return '';
        }
        return text;
    },

    /* Returns the number of keys held by a set. */
    _size: function (set) {
        var total = 0;
        var key = '';
        for (key in set) {
            if (set.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                total = total + 1;
            }
        }
        return total;
    },

    /* Returns true when a participant list already carries an investor. */
    _carries: function (entries, investorId) {
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== entries.length; i++) {
            if (entries[i].value === investorId) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    },

    /* Splits identifiers into batches no larger than BATCH_SIZE. */
    _batch: function (values) {
        var batches = [];
        var current = [];
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== values.length; i++) {
            current.push(values[i]);
            if (current.length === this.BATCH_SIZE) {
                batches.push(current);
                current = [];
            }
        }
        if (current.length !== 0) {
            batches.push(current);
        }
        return batches;
    },

    type: 'InvestorPortfolioService'
};</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_id>b2dd85fad788f85504376a697f958427</sys_id><sys_name>InvestorPortfolioService</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_bst_startuptrk.IngestionLogger</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Structured run scoped ingestion events for the flow execution log with skip the record and continue the run semantics, the run summary and the run completion marker. Records record identity as opaque references only, as a staging row identifier or an arrival ordinal, and omits any personal, address, locator or free form external value in favour of a redaction placeholder. Implements prompt 4.0 and prompt 8.0.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>IngestionLogger</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>var IngestionLogger = Class.create();
IngestionLogger.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.SOURCE = 'x_bst_startuptrk.ingestion';
        this.props = new AppProperties();
        this.LEVELS = { debug: 10, info: 20, warn: 30, error: 40 };
        this.PROVENANCE = ['live', 'fallback'];
        this.CONTROL = /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/g;
        this.VALUE_LIMIT = 200;
        this.EVENT_LIMIT = 1000;
        this.UNIDENTIFIED = '(unidentified)';
        this.BLANK = '(blank)';
        this.REDACTED = '(redacted)';
        this.OPAQUE = /^(?:[0-9a-f]{32}|[a-z_]{1,24}:[0-9A-Za-z_.-]{1,64})$/;
        this.CHOICE_LABEL = /^[0-9A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z +._\/-]{0,39}$/;
        this.ADDRESS = /[^\s]*@[^\s]*/g;
        this.LOCATOR = /[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:\/\/[^\s]*/g;
        this.SENSITIVE = {
            name: true, person_name: true, startup_name: true, investor_name: true,
            person_title: true, job_title: true, title: true, bio: true, description: true,
            short_description: true, summary: true, contact_email: true, email: true,
            linkedin_url: true, website: true, logo_url: true, url: true, job_url: true,
            source_url: true, raw_payload: true, payload: true,
            headquarters_location: true, location: true, job_location: true,
            lead_investor: true, lead_investor_name: true,
            participating_investors: true, participating_investor_names: true
        };
        this.FREE_TEXT = { message: true, reason: true, supplied: true, expected: true };
        this.threshold = this._threshold();
        this.reset('');
    },

    /* Clears the run scoped counters and the event buffer. Implements prompt 4.0
       run summary. */
    reset: function (runId) {
        this.runId = this._scrub(runId);
        this.processed = 0;
        this.rejected = 0;
        this.skipped = 0;
        this.duplicates = 0;
        this.unmatched = 0;
        this.deviations = 0;
        this.events = [];
        this.truncated = 0;
        this.ordinals = {};
        return this;
    },

    /* Adopts a run identifier without clearing the counters or the event buffer.
       Implements prompt 4.0 run summary. */
    useRun: function (runId) {
        if (runId) {
            this.runId = this._scrub(runId);
        }
        return this.runId;
    },

    /* Returns the structured events recorded so far and clears the buffer. The flow's
       Log action writes them to the flow execution log.
       Implements prompt 8.0 ingestion logging. */
    drainEvents: function () {
        var drained = this.events;
        this.events = [];
        return drained;
    },

    /* Returns the structured events without clearing the buffer. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    getEvents: function () {
        return this.events;
    },

    /* Returns the run scoped counters. rule3_deviations counts the unmatched choice
       values that could not be stored as Other because their prompt 1.0 choice list
       declares no Other member. Implements prompt 4.0 run summary. */
    counters: function () {
        return {
            run: this.runId,
            processed: this.processed,
            rejected: this.rejected,
            skipped: this.skipped,
            duplicates: this.duplicates,
            unmatched: this.unmatched,
            rule3_deviations: this.deviations
        };
    },

    /* Returns the next opaque reference of one kind for the current run, counted from one.
       It is assigned in arrival order and is derived from nothing the record carries, so
       it correlates the log lines about one incoming row without representing any of its
       values. Implements prompt 8.0 logging. */
    ordinal: function (kind) {
        var safeKind = this._scrub(kind).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z_]/g, '');
        if (safeKind === '') {
            safeKind = 'row';
        }
        if (!this.ordinals.hasOwnProperty(safeKind)) {
            this.ordinals[safeKind] = 0;
        }
        this.ordinals[safeKind] = this.ordinals[safeKind] + 1;
        return this.reference(safeKind, String(this.ordinals[safeKind]));
    },

    /* Returns an opaque reference for one kind and token, which is the only form of
       record identity this logger records. Implements prompt 8.0 logging. */
    reference: function (kind, token) {
        var safeKind = this._scrub(kind).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z_]/g, '');
        var safeToken = this._scrub(token).replace(/[^0-9A-Za-z_.-]/g, '');
        if (safeKind === '') {
            safeKind = 'record';
        }
        if (safeToken === '') {
            return this.UNIDENTIFIED;
        }
        if (safeToken.length > 64) {
            safeToken = safeToken.substring(0, 64);
        }
        return safeKind + ':' + safeToken;
    },

    /* Records an informational event. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    info: function (runId, message) {
        return this._record(runId, 'info', 'info', { message: message });
    },

    /* Records a warning event. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    warn: function (runId, message) {
        return this._record(runId, 'warn', 'warning', { message: message });
    },

    /* Records a per record failure, counts the skip and lets the run continue.
       Implements prompt 8.0 skip the record and continue the run. */
    skipRecord: function (runId, recordType, identifier, reason) {
        this.skipped = this.skipped + 1;
        this._record(runId, 'error', 'record_skipped', {
            record_type: recordType,
            identifier: this._identifier(identifier),
            reason: reason
        });
        return true;
    },

    /* Records a record rejected by the mandatory field rule and counts the rejection.
       Implements prompt 4.0 cleaning rule 4. */
    rejectRecord: function (runId, recordType, identifier, reason) {
        this.rejected = this.rejected + 1;
        this._record(runId, 'warn', 'record_rejected', {
            record_type: recordType,
            identifier: this._identifier(identifier),
            reason: reason
        });
        return true;
    },

    /* Records a Startup duplicated within one batch and counts the duplicate.
       Implements prompt 4.0 cleaning rule 2. */
    duplicateRecord: function (runId, recordType, identifier) {
        this.duplicates = this.duplicates + 1;
        this._record(runId, 'warn', 'record_duplicate', {
            record_type: recordType,
            identifier: this._identifier(identifier)
        });
        return true;
    },

    /* Records a staged value whose encoding could not be decoded. Implements prompt 4.0. */
    invalidEncoding: function (runId, field, value, reason) {
        this._record(runId, 'warn', 'value_undecodable', {
            field: field,
            value: this._choiceValue(field, value),
            reason: reason
        });
        return true;
    },

    /* Records a choice value that matched no member of its choice list, together with
       the outcome applied, and counts it. A deviation flag additionally counts the value
       against rule3_deviations and marks the event, which is the case where the choice
       list declares no Other member for cleaning rule 3 to store.
       Implements prompt 4.0 cleaning rule 3. */
    unmatchedChoice: function (runId, recordType, field, value, outcome, deviation) {
        this.unmatched = this.unmatched + 1;
        if (deviation === true) {
            this.deviations = this.deviations + 1;
        }
        this._record(runId, 'warn', 'choice_unmatched', {
            record_type: recordType,
            field: field,
            value: this._choiceValue(field, value),
            outcome: outcome,
            deviation: deviation === true
        });
        return true;
    },

    /* Counts one successfully applied record. Implements prompt 4.0 run summary. */
    countProcessed: function () {
        this.processed = this.processed + 1;
        return this.processed;
    },

    /* Validates the run provenance and records the run summary event carrying every run
       scoped counter. It writes no property: the completion marker the cadence guard reads
       is written by markRunComplete once the run's final checks have passed.
       Implements prompt 4.0 provenance and prompt 8.0 ingestion logging. */
    writeRunSummary: function (runId, provenance, sourceSystem) {
        if (runId) {
            this.runId = this._scrub(runId);
        }
        var mode = this._provenance(provenance);
        var summary = this.counters();
        summary.source_system = this.sourceOfRun(sourceSystem);
        summary.provenance = mode;
        summary.events_dropped = this.truncated;
        summary.logged = false;
        if (mode === '') {
            this._record(this.runId, 'error', 'run_summary_provenance_invalid', {
                supplied: provenance,
                expected: this.PROVENANCE.join(' or ')
            });
            return summary;
        }
        this._record(this.runId, 'info', 'run_summary', {
            provenance: mode,
            source_system: summary.source_system,
            processed: this.processed,
            rejected: this.rejected,
            skipped: this.skipped,
            duplicates: this.duplicates,
            unmatched: this.unmatched,
            rule3_deviations: this.deviations,
            events_dropped: this.truncated
        });
        summary.logged = true;
        return summary;
    },

    /* Records one source system's run as complete with its provenance, which stamps the
       marker the cadence guard reads, and reports the value that read back. This is the
       run's last write and is to be called only once every final check has passed.
       Implements prompt 4.0 provenance and prompt 10.0 criterion 4. */
    markRunComplete: function (runId, provenance, sourceSystem) {
        if (runId) {
            this.runId = this._scrub(runId);
        }
        var source = this.sourceOfRun(sourceSystem);
        var mode = this._provenance(provenance);
        if (mode === '') {
            this._record(this.runId, 'error', 'run_completion_provenance_invalid', {
                supplied: provenance,
                expected: this.PROVENANCE.join(' or ')
            });
            return { ok: false, provenance: '', stamp: '', verified: false,
                reason: 'unknown provenance' };
        }
        var recorded = this.props.completeRun(source, this.runId, mode);
        if (!recorded.ok) {
            this._record(this.runId, 'error', 'run_completion_refused', {
                source_system: source,
                reason: recorded.reason
            });
            return { ok: false, provenance: recorded.provenance, stamp: '', verified: false,
                reason: recorded.reason };
        }
        var verified = this.props.getRunProvenance(source) === mode
            && this.props.getLastSuccessAt(source) === recorded.stamp;
        this._record(this.runId, 'info', 'run_completed', {
            source_system: source,
            provenance: mode,
            stamp: recorded.stamp,
            verified: verified
        });
        return { ok: true, provenance: mode, stamp: recorded.stamp, verified: verified,
            reason: '' };
    },

    /* Returns the source system a run belongs to: the value supplied when the caller names
       one, otherwise the text before the run identifier's first hyphen.
       Implements prompt 4.0 run summary. */
    sourceOfRun: function (sourceSystem) {
        var supplied = this._scrub(sourceSystem === undefined ? '' : sourceSystem)
            .trim().toLowerCase();
        if (supplied !== '') {
            return supplied;
        }
        return String(this.runId).split('-')[0];
    },

    _record: function (runId, severity, event, detail) {
        if (runId) {
            this.runId = this._scrub(runId);
        }
        var entry = {
            severity: severity,
            source: this.SOURCE,
            run: this.runId === '' ? this.UNIDENTIFIED : this.runId,
            event: this._scrub(event)
        };
        var key = '';
        for (key in detail) {
            if (!detail.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                continue;
            }
            var safeKey = this._scrub(key);
            entry[safeKey] = this._detail(safeKey, detail[key]);

        if (this.events.length !== this.EVENT_LIMIT) {
            this.events.push(entry);

            this.truncated = this.truncated + 1;
        }
        this._emit(severity, entry);
        return entry;
    },

    /* Writes one line to the platform application log through gs.error, gs.warn or
       gs.info when logging.level permits the severity. The severity is resolved through
       AppProperties.normaliseSeverity, which is the one severity policy in the
       application, so a severity this logger does not recognise is written at error.
       Returns true when the line was written. Implements prompt 8.0. */
    _emit: function (severity, entry) {
        var level = this.props.normaliseSeverity(severity);
        if (this.LEVELS[level] < this.threshold) {
            return false;
        }
        var line = this._line(entry);
        if (level === 'error') {
            gs.error(line);
            return true;
        }
        if (level === 'warn') {
            gs.warn(line);
            return true;
        }
        gs.info(line);
        return true;
    },

    _line: function (entry) {
        var parts = [];
        var key = '';
        for (key in entry) {
            if (!entry.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                continue;
            }

    /* Returns one log ready detail value. An identifier stays opaque, a value from a
       field that can carry personal data is omitted and replaced by the redaction
       placeholder, free text has address like and locator like substrings replaced, and
       every other value is scrubbed. No value is logged in a derived or encoded form,
       so no logged token can be tested against a guessed value.
       Implements prompt 8.0 logging. */
    _detail: function (key, value) {
        if (key === 'identifier') {
            return this._identifier(value);
        }
        if (this.SENSITIVE[key]) {
            return this.REDACTED;
        }
        if (this.FREE_TEXT[key]) {
            return this._safeText(value);
        }
        return this._scrub(value);
    },

    /* Returns free text with every address like and locator like substring replaced by
       the redaction placeholder. Implements prompt 8.0 logging. */
    _safeText: function (value) {
        var text = this._scrub(value);
        text = text.replace(this.ADDRESS, this.REDACTED);
        text = text.replace(this.LOCATOR, this.REDACTED);
        return text;
    },

    /* Returns an unmatched choice value only when it has the shape of a short
       enumeration label on a field that cannot carry personal data; anything else is
       omitted and replaced by the redaction placeholder.
       Implements prompt 4.0 cleaning rule 3 logging. */
    _choiceValue: function (field, value) {
        var text = this._scrub(value);
        if (text === '') {
            return this.BLANK;
        }
        if (this.SENSITIVE[this._scrub(field)]) {
            return this.REDACTED;
        }
        if (this.CHOICE_LABEL.test(text)) {
            return text;
        }
        return this.REDACTED;
    },

    /* Returns true when a value is already an opaque reference: a record identifier, or
       one or more kind prefixed tokens separated by single spaces. */
    _opaque: function (text) {
        var parts = String(text).split(' ');
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== parts.length; i++) {
            if (parts[i] === '') {
                continue;
            }
            if (!this.OPAQUE.test(parts[i])) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    },

    /* Returns a record identity that is safe to log: an already opaque reference is kept
       and anything else is omitted and replaced by the redaction placeholder.
       Implements prompt 8.0 logging. */
    _identifier: function (identifier) {
        var text = this._scrub(identifier);
        if (text === '') {
            return this.UNIDENTIFIED;
        }
        if (text === 'undefined') {
            return this.UNIDENTIFIED;
        }
        if (text === 'null') {
            return this.UNIDENTIFIED;
        }
        if (this._opaque(text)) {
            return text;
        }
        return this.REDACTED;
    },

    _provenance: function (provenance) {
        var mode = this._scrub(provenance).toLowerCase();
        var i = 0;
        for (i = 0; i !== this.PROVENANCE.length; i++) {
            if (mode === this.PROVENANCE[i]) {
                return mode;
            }
        }
        return '';
    },

    _threshold: function () {
        var configured = String(this.props.getLoggingLevel());
        var weight = this.LEVELS[configured];
        if (weight === undefined) {
            return this.LEVELS.info;
        }
        return weight;
    },

    _scrub: function (value) {
        if (value === null) {
            return '';
        }
        if (value === undefined) {
            return '';
        }
        var text = String(value).replace(this.CONTROL, ' ').replace(/"/g, "'").trim();
        if (text.length > this.VALUE_LIMIT) {
            text = text.substring(0, this.VALUE_LIMIT);
        }
        return text;
    },

    type: 'IngestionLogger'

Implements prompt 3.0.</description><enforce_acl>19e095d1b3f39037c6fbf3107b30e63c</enforce_acl><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Startup list</name><operation_script>(function process(request, response) {
    var builder = new RestResponseBuilder();
    try {
        var limiter = new RateLimitService();
        if (limiter.reject(response, '/startups')) {
            return;
        }
        if (builder.rejectUnauthorisedRead(response)) {
            return;
        }
        var helper = new RestQueryHelper();
        var limit = helper.getLimit(request);
        var offsetParam = helper.getOffset(request);
        if (!offsetParam.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, offsetParam.error);
            return;
        }
        var offset = offsetParam.value;
        var fields = ['name', 'description', 'industry', 'founded_year', 'headquarters_location', 'website', 'logo_url', 'funding_stage', 'total_funding_usd', 'active', 'institutional_funding_last_5yrs', 'employee_count_range'];
        var search = new StartupSearchService();
        var supplied = search.readFilters(request, helper);
        if (!supplied.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, supplied.error);
            return;
        }
        var plan = search.buildPlan(supplied.filters, search.appliesInclusion());
        var applyConditions = function (query) {
            search.applyPlan(query, plan);
        };
        var counted = builder.countState('x_bst_startuptrk_startup', applyConditions);
        if (builder.rejectDeniedCount(response, counted)) {
            return;
        }
        var records = search.search(plan, limit, offset);
        var rows = [];
        while (records.next()) {
            var row = builder.serialize(records, fields);
            rows.push(row);
        }
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(builder.page(rows, counted.total, limit, offset));
    } catch (error) {
        builder.serverError(response, error);

Implements prompt 3.0.</description><enforce_acl>19e095d1b3f39037c6fbf3107b30e63c</enforce_acl><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Founder list</name><operation_script>(function process(request, response) {
    var builder = new RestResponseBuilder();
    try {
        var limiter = new RateLimitService();
        if (limiter.reject(response, '/founders')) {
            return;
        }
        if (builder.rejectUnauthorisedRead(response)) {
            return;
        }
        var helper = new RestQueryHelper();
        var limit = helper.getLimit(request);
        var offsetParam = helper.getOffset(request);
        if (!offsetParam.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, offsetParam.error);
            return;
        }
        var offset = offsetParam.value;
        var fields = ['name', 'startup', 'title', 'bio', 'linkedin_url', 'contact_email'];
        var startupFilter = helper.getSysIdParam(request, 'startup');
        if (!startupFilter.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, startupFilter.error);
            return;
        }
        var nameFilter = helper.getTextParam(request, 'name');
        var applyConditions = function (query) {
            if (startupFilter.value !== '') {
                query.addQuery('startup', startupFilter.value);
            }
            if (nameFilter !== '') {
                query.addQuery('name', 'CONTAINS', nameFilter);
            }
        };
        var counted = builder.countState('x_bst_startuptrk_founder', applyConditions);
        if (builder.rejectDeniedCount(response, counted)) {
            return;
        }
        var records = new GlideRecordSecure('x_bst_startuptrk_founder');
        applyConditions(records);
        records.orderBy('name');
        records.orderBy('sys_id');
        records.chooseWindow(offset, offset + limit);
        /* The exact total already came from the aggregate count, so the windowed
           query does not count its own result set. Implements prompt 3.0 pagination. */
        records.setNoCount();
        records.query();
        var rows = [];
        while (records.next()) {
            var row = builder.serialize(records, fields);
            rows.push(row);
        }
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(builder.page(rows, counted.total, limit, offset));
    } catch (error) {
        builder.serverError(response, error);
    }
})(request, response);</operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_bst_startuptrk/v1/founders</operation_uri><produces>application/json</produces><produces_customized>true</produces_customized><relative_path>/founders</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>false</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Returns a paginated founder list carrying total_count. Implements prompt 3.0.</description><enforce_acl>19e095d1b3f39037c6fbf3107b30e63c</enforce_acl><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Investor list</name><operation_script>(function process(request, response) {
    var builder = new RestResponseBuilder();
    try {
        var limiter = new RateLimitService();
        if (limiter.reject(response, '/investors')) {
            return;
        }
        if (builder.rejectUnauthorisedRead(response)) {
            return;
        }
        var helper = new RestQueryHelper();
        var limit = helper.getLimit(request);
        var offsetParam = helper.getOffset(request);
        if (!offsetParam.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, offsetParam.error);
            return;
        }
        var offset = offsetParam.value;
        var fields = ['name', 'type', 'focus_areas', 'website', 'aum_usd', 'portfolio_count'];
        var nameFilter = helper.getTextParam(request, 'name');
        var typeFilter = helper.getChoiceParam(request, 'type', ['VC', 'Angel', 'PE', 'Corporate', 'Accelerator']);
        if (!typeFilter.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, typeFilter.error);
            return;
        }
        var applyConditions = function (query) {
            if (nameFilter !== '') {
                query.addQuery('name', 'CONTAINS', nameFilter);
            }
            if (typeFilter.value !== '') {
                query.addQuery('type', typeFilter.value);
            }
        };
        var counted = builder.countState('x_bst_startuptrk_investor', applyConditions);
        if (builder.rejectDeniedCount(response, counted)) {
            return;
        }
        var records = new GlideRecordSecure('x_bst_startuptrk_investor');
        applyConditions(records);
        records.orderBy('name');
        records.orderBy('sys_id');
        records.chooseWindow(offset, offset + limit);
        /* The exact total already came from the aggregate count, so the windowed
           query does not count its own result set. Implements prompt 3.0 pagination. */
        records.setNoCount();
        records.query();
        var rows = [];
        while (records.next()) {
            var row = builder.serialize(records, fields);
            rows.push(row);
        }
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(builder.page(rows, counted.total, limit, offset));
    } catch (error) {
        builder.serverError(response, error);
    }
})(request, response);</operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_bst_startuptrk/v1/investors</operation_uri><produces>application/json</produces><produces_customized>true</produces_customized><relative_path>/investors</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>false</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Returns a paginated investor list carrying total_count. <record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json</consumes><consumes_customized>true</consumes_customized><default_operation>false</default_operation><description>Returns a paginated funding round list carrying total_count. Implements prompt 3.0.</description><enforce_acl>19e095d1b3f39037c6fbf3107b30e63c</enforce_acl><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Funding round list</name><operation_script>(function process(request, response) {
    var builder = new RestResponseBuilder();
    try {
        var limiter = new RateLimitService();
        if (limiter.reject(response, '/funding-rounds')) {
            return;
        }
        if (builder.rejectUnauthorisedRead(response)) {
            return;
        }
        var helper = new RestQueryHelper();
        var limit = helper.getLimit(request);
        var offsetParam = helper.getOffset(request);
        if (!offsetParam.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, offsetParam.error);
            return;
        }
        var offset = offsetParam.value;
        var fields = ['startup', 'round_type', 'amount_usd', 'round_date', 'lead_investor', 'valuation_usd', 'source_url'];
        var startupFilter = helper.getSysIdParam(request, 'startup');
        if (!startupFilter.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, startupFilter.error);
            return;
        }
        var round_typeFilter = helper.getChoiceParam(request, 'round_type', ['Pre-Seed', 'Seed', 'Series A', 'Series B', 'Series C+', 'Growth', 'Public', 'Acquired']);
        if (!round_typeFilter.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, round_typeFilter.error);
            return;
        }
        var applyConditions = function (query) {
            if (startupFilter.value !== '') {
                query.addQuery('startup', startupFilter.value);
            }
            if (round_typeFilter.value !== '') {
                query.addQuery('round_type', round_typeFilter.value);
            }
        };
        var counted = builder.countState('x_bst_startuptrk_fundinground', applyConditions);
        if (builder.rejectDeniedCount(response, counted)) {
            return;
        }
        var records = new GlideRecordSecure('x_bst_startuptrk_fundinground');
        applyConditions(records);
        records.orderByDesc('round_date');
        records.orderBy('sys_id');
        records.chooseWindow(offset, offset + limit);
        /* The exact total already came from the aggregate count, so the windowed
           query does not count its own result set. Implements prompt 3.0 pagination. */
        records.setNoCount();
        records.query();
        var rows = [];
        var roundIds = [];
        while (records.next()) {
            var row = builder.serialize(records, fields);
            roundIds.push(records.getUniqueValue());
            rows.push(row);
        }
        var participants = new InvestorPortfolioService()
            .participantsForRounds(roundIds);
        var r = 0;
        for (r = 0; r !== rows.length; r++) {
            var linked = participants[roundIds[r]];
            rows[r].participating_investors = linked ? linked : [];
        }
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(builder.page(rows, counted.total, limit, offset));
    } catch (error) {
        builder.serverError(response, error);
    }
})(request, response);</operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_bst_startuptrk/v1/funding-rounds</operation_uri><produces>application/json</produces><produces_customized>true</produces_customized><relative_path>/funding-rounds</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>false</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Returns a paginated funding round list carrying total_count. Implements prompt 3.0.</short_description><sys_id>e00a20a90ba7681f99325f977e5916d8</sys_id><sys_name>Funding round list</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><web_service_definition display_value="Boston Startup Tracker API">bd4c1ca01e5757533373c2a4aca536c0</web_service_definition><web_service_version/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

Implements prompt 3.0.</description><enforce_acl>9939250e27ddedeff95067e43f879d62</enforce_acl><http_method>POST</http_method><name>Funding round create</name><operation_script>(function process(request, response) {
    var builder = new RestResponseBuilder();
    try {
        var limiter = new RateLimitService();
        if (limiter.reject(response, '/funding-rounds')) {
            return;
        }
        if (builder.rejectUnauthorisedWrite(response)) {
            return;
        }
        var helper = new RestQueryHelper();
        var fields = ['startup', 'round_type', 'amount_usd', 'round_date', 'lead_investor', 'valuation_usd', 'source_url'];
        var writable = [
            { field: 'startup', type: 'reference', table: 'x_bst_startuptrk_startup', mandatory: true },
            { field: 'round_type', type: 'choice', choices: ['Pre-Seed', 'Seed', 'Series A', 'Series B', 'Series C+', 'Growth', 'Public', 'Acquired'] },
            { field: 'amount_usd', type: 'currency' },
            { field: 'round_date', type: 'date', mandatory: true },
            { field: 'lead_investor', type: 'reference', table: 'x_bst_startuptrk_investor' },
            { field: 'valuation_usd', type: 'currency' },
            { field: 'source_url', type: 'url', max: 255 }
        ];
        var participatingInvestors = function (roundId) {
            var linked = new InvestorPortfolioService()
                .participantsForRounds([roundId])[roundId];
            return linked ? linked : [];
        };
        if (builder.rejectNonJsonBody(request, response)) {
            return;
        }
        var payload = null;
        try {
            if (request.body) {
                payload = request.body.data;
            }
        } catch (bodyError) {
            builder.badRequest(response, 'Request body is required and must be JSON');
            return;
        }
        var checked = helper.validateBody(payload, writable, true);
        if (!checked.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, checked.error);
            return;
        }
        var record = new GlideRecordSecure('x_bst_startuptrk_fundinground');
        record.initialize();
        var field = '';
        for (field in checked.values) {
            if (checked.values.hasOwnProperty(field)) {
                record.setValue(field, checked.values[field]);
            }
        }
        var inserted = record.insert();
        if (!inserted) {
            builder.badRequest(response, 'Record could not be created');
            return;
        }
        var created = new GlideRecordSecure('x_bst_startuptrk_fundinground');
        if (!created.get(inserted)) {
            response.setStatus(201);
            response.setBody({ sys_id: String(inserted) });
            return;
        }
        var row = builder.serialize(created, fields);
        row.participating_investors = participatingInvestors(String(inserted));
        response.setStatus(201);
        response.setBody(row);
    } catch (error) {
        builder.serverError(response, error);
    }
})(request, response);</operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_bst_startuptrk/v1/funding-rounds</operation_uri><produces>application/json</produces><produces_customized>true</produces_customized><relative_path>/funding-rounds</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>false</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Creates one funding round record. Implements prompt 3.0.</description><enforce_acl>19e095d1b3f39037c6fbf3107b30e63c</enforce_acl><http_method>GET</http_method><name>News article list</name><operation_script>(function process(request, response) {
    var builder = new RestResponseBuilder();
    try {
        var limiter = new RateLimitService();
        if (limiter.reject(response, '/news')) {
            return;
        }
        if (builder.rejectUnauthorisedRead(response)) {
            return;
        }
        var helper = new RestQueryHelper();
        var limit = helper.getLimit(request);
        var offsetParam = helper.getOffset(request);
        if (!offsetParam.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, offsetParam.error);
            return;
        }
        var offset = offsetParam.value;
        var fields = ['startup', 'title', 'source', 'url', 'published_date', 'summary'];
        var startupFilter = helper.getSysIdParam(request, 'startup');
        if (!startupFilter.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, startupFilter.error);
            return;
        }
        var sourceFilter = helper.getTextParam(request, 'source');
        var applyConditions = function (query) {
            if (startupFilter.value !== '') {
                query.addQuery('startup', startupFilter.value);
            }
            if (sourceFilter !== '') {
                query.addQuery('source', 'CONTAINS', sourceFilter);
            }
        };
        var counted = builder.countState('x_bst_startuptrk_newsarticle', applyConditions);
        if (builder.rejectDeniedCount(response, counted)) {
            return;
        }
        var records = new GlideRecordSecure('x_bst_startuptrk_newsarticle');
        applyConditions(records);
        records.orderByDesc('published_date');
        records.orderBy('sys_id');
        records.chooseWindow(offset, offset + limit);
        /* The exact total already came from the aggregate count, so the windowed
           query does not count its own result set. Implements prompt 3.0 pagination. */
        records.setNoCount();
        records.query();
        var rows = [];
        while (records.next()) {
            var row = builder.serialize(records, fields);
            rows.push(row);
        }
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(builder.page(rows, counted.total, limit, offset));
    } catch (error) {
        builder.serverError(response, error);
    }
})(request, response);</operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_bst_startuptrk/v1/news</operation_uri><produces>application/json</produces><produces_customized>true</produces_customized><relative_path>/news</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>false</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Returns a paginated news article list carrying total_count.     var builder = new RestResponseBuilder();
    try {
        var limiter = new RateLimitService();
        if (limiter.reject(response, '/news')) {
            return;
        }
        if (builder.rejectUnauthorisedWrite(response)) {
            return;
        }
        var helper = new RestQueryHelper();
        var recordId = helper.getPathSysId(request, 'id');
        if (!recordId.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, recordId.error);
            return;
        }
        var fields = ['startup', 'title', 'source', 'url', 'published_date', 'summary'];
        var writable = [
            { field: 'startup', type: 'reference', table: 'x_bst_startuptrk_startup', mandatory: true },
            { field: 'title', type: 'string', max: 255, mandatory: true },
            { field: 'source', type: 'string', max: 100 },
            { field: 'url', type: 'url', max: 255 },
            { field: 'published_date', type: 'date' },
            { field: 'summary', type: 'string', max: 2000 }
        ];
        if (builder.rejectNonJsonBody(request, response)) {
            return;
        }
        var payload = null;
        try {
            if (request.body) {
                payload = request.body.data;
            }
        } catch (bodyError) {
            builder.badRequest(response, 'Request body is required and must be JSON');
            return;
        }
        var checked = helper.validateBody(payload, writable, false);
        if (!checked.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, checked.error);
            return;
        }
        var record = new GlideRecordSecure('x_bst_startuptrk_newsarticle');
        if (!record.get(recordId.value)) {
            builder.notFound(response, 'Record not found');
            return;
        }
        var field = '';
        for (field in checked.values) {
            if (checked.values.hasOwnProperty(field)) {
                record.setValue(field, checked.values[field]);
            }
        }
        if (!record.update()) {
            builder.badRequest(response, 'Record could not be updated');
            return;
        }
        var committed = new GlideRecordSecure('x_bst_startuptrk_newsarticle');
        if (!committed.get(recordId.value)) {
            builder.notFound(response, 'Record not found');
            return;
        }
        var row = builder.serialize(committed, fields);
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(row);
    } catch (error) {
        builder.serverError(response, error);
    }

<record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json</consumes><consumes_customized>true</consumes_customized><default_operation>false</default_operation><description>Returns the paginated executives for one startup. Implements prompt 3.0 nested sub resource.</description><enforce_acl>19e095d1b3f39037c6fbf3107b30e63c</enforce_acl><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Executives for startup</name><operation_script>(function process(request, response) {
    var builder = new RestResponseBuilder();
    try {
        var limiter = new RateLimitService();
        if (limiter.reject(response, '/founders/{startup_id}/executives')) {
            return;
        }
        if (builder.rejectUnauthorisedRead(response)) {
            return;
        }
        var helper = new RestQueryHelper();
        var limit = helper.getLimit(request);
        var offsetParam = helper.getOffset(request);
        if (!offsetParam.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, offsetParam.error);
            return;
        }
        var offset = offsetParam.value;
        var fields = ['name', 'startup', 'title', 'bio', 'linkedin_url', 'contact_email'];
        var startupId = helper.getPathSysId(request, 'startup_id');
        if (!startupId.ok) {
            builder.badRequest(response, startupId.error);
            return;
        }
        var applyConditions = function (query) {
            query.addQuery('startup', startupId.value);
        };
        var counted = builder.countState('x_bst_startuptrk_executive', applyConditions);
        if (builder.rejectDeniedCount(response, counted)) {
            return;
        }
        var records = new GlideRecordSecure('x_bst_startuptrk_executive');
        applyConditions(records);
        records.orderBy('name');
        records.orderBy('sys_id');
        records.chooseWindow(offset, offset + limit);
        /* The exact total already came from the aggregate count, so the windowed
           query does not count its own result set. Implements prompt 3.0 pagination. */
        records.setNoCount();
        records.query();
        var rows = [];
        while (records.next()) {
            var row = builder.serialize(records, fields);
            rows.push(row);
        }
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(builder.page(rows, counted.total, limit, offset));
    } catch (error) {
        builder.serverError(response, error);
    }
})(request, response);</operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_bst_startuptrk/v1/founders/{startup_id}/executives</operation_uri><produces>application/json</produces><produces_customized>true</produces_customized><relative_path>/founders/{startup_id}/executives</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>false</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Returns the paginated executives for one startup. Implements prompt 3.0 nested sub resource.</short_description><sys_id>e8b352e98a5b0a7fb6a717e042f7a714</sys_id><sys_name>Executives for startup</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><web_service_definition display_value="Boston Startup Tracker API">bd4c1ca01e5757533373c2a4aca536c0</web_service_definition><web_service_version/><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>true</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_bst_startuptrk_fundinground</collection><condition/><description>Delegates Investor portfolio_count recalculation to InvestorPortfolioService for the previous and the new lead investor and for every linked participating investor. Implements prompt 1.4.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><is_rest>false</is_rest><name>Recalculate investor portfolio on funding round</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><script>(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    var service = new InvestorPortfolioService();
    var affected = [];
    affected.push(current.getValue('lead_investor'));
    if (previous) {
        affected.push(previous.getValue('lead_investor'));
    }
    var linked = service.participantsForRounds([current.getUniqueValue()])[
        current.getUniqueValue()];
    var i = 0;
    if (linked) {
        for (i = 0; i !== linked.length; i++) {
            affected.push(linked[i].value);
        }
    }
    service.recalculateMany(affected);
})(current, previous);</script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>e818e5e8cba9e7a3ea0ec7b252855b3a</sys_id><sys_name>Recalculate investor portfolio on funding round</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><template/><when>after</when><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_c579b36901121eb990c9773c07fea568
sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>true</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_bst_startuptrk_m2m_round_investor</collection><condition/><description>Refreshes the derived FundingRound.participating_investors projection and delegates Investor portfolio_count recalculation to InvestorPortfolioService, for the current and the previous investor and round on insert, update and delete. Implements prompt 1.4 and prompt 1.5.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><is_rest>false</is_rest><name>Recalculate investor portfolio on round investor link</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><script>(function executeRule(current, previous) {
var service = new InvestorPortfolioService();
var investors = [];
var rounds = [];
investors.push(current.getValue('investor'));
rounds.push(current.getValue('funding_round'));
if (previous) {
investors.push(previous.getValue('investor'));
rounds.push(previous.getValue('funding_round'));
}
var i = 0;
var stale = [];
for (i = 0; i !== rounds.length; i++) {
if (!rounds[i]) {
continue;
}
if (!service.refreshRoundParticipants(rounds[i])) {
stale.push(String(rounds[i]));
}
}
if (stale.length !== 0) {
gs.error('[x_bst_startuptrk.m2m_round_investor] participating_investors may be stale'
+ ' for funding round(s) ' + stale.join(' '));
}
service.recalculateMany(investors);
})(current, previous);</script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>c579b36901121eb990c9773c07fea568</sys_id><sys_name>Recalculate investor portfolio on round investor link</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><template/><when>after</when><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_bst_startuptrk_startup</collection><condition/><description>Trims whitespace on Startup string fields and rejects records missing a mandatory name or headquarters location. Implements prompt 4.0 cleaning rules 1 and 4.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><is_rest>false</is_rest><name>Trim and validate startup</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><script>(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    var trimmable = ['name', 'description', 'headquarters_location', 'website',
        'logo_url', 'industry', 'funding_stage', 'employee_count_range'];
    var i = 0;
    for (i = 0; i !== trimmable.length; i++) {
        var field = trimmable[i];
        var value = current.getValue(field);
        if (value === null) {
            continue;
        }
        var trimmed = String(value).trim();
        if (trimmed !== String(value)) {
            current.setValue(field, trimmed);
        }
    }
    if (String(current.getValue('name')).trim() === '') {
        gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage('Startup name is required.'));
        current.setAbortAction(true);
        return;
    }
    if (String(current.getValue('headquarters_location')).trim() === '') {
        gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage('Startup headquarters location is required.'));
        current.setAbortAction(true);
        return;
    }
    /* Aborts when active is empty. An insert that leaves active unset carries the
       dictionary default true. Implements prompt 4.0 rejection of partial records. */
    var activeValue = String(current.getValue('active'));
    if (activeValue.trim() === '') {
        gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage('Startup active is required.'));
        current.setAbortAction(true);
    }
})(current, previous);</script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>db47106f01240b829205ce83010abe5d</sys_id><sys_name>Trim and validate startup</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><sys_policy/><template/><when>before</when><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script></record_update>

    var properties = new AppProperties();
    var windowSeconds = properties.getRateLimitWindowSeconds();
    var limiter = new RateLimitService();
    var removed = limiter.prune(windowSeconds);
    gs.info('[x_bst_startuptrk.prune_rate_limit_counters] removed ' + removed
        + ' closed window row(s) older than ' + windowSeconds + ' second(s)');
})();</script><sys_class_name>sysauto_script</sys_class_name><sys_id>f8e4054aa6edd8b63bf0b1a333f3e244</sys_id><sys_name>Prune rate limit counters</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Boston Startup Tracker" source="x_bst_startuptrk">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="Boston Startup Tracker">1c16ba51b0975d36296c3fe303eb66d3</sys_scope><time_zone/><upgrade_safe>false</upgrade_safe><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00</sys_updated_on></sysauto_script></record_update>
